quests.name: A Young Giant's Tooth
quests.offer:
Hmm. A new one. Small yet. You will grow. Everything on the plateau grows, or gets stepped on.
Every giant of the camp wears a rhino's tooth on a thong, so the others know it is no ogre. Hidewife Marna cuts the thongs. She sits a few steps to the south.
Will you fetch your tooth and show it to me?
quests.declined: Then stand there. You are good at it.
quests.started: Marna. A few steps south. Go.

steps.journal: Ask Hidewife Marna, a few steps south of Elder Hrolmog, for a young giant's tooth thong.
steps.says: Hrolmog sent you? Bend down. Further. There. A rhino's tooth, and my best hide. Do not chew it. Nothing to pay, little one.

steps.journal: Show the young giant's tooth thong to Elder Hrolmog.
steps.says: Good tooth. Now the camp knows you. When you are big, you will pull your own from a rhino.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests): the hillgiant's level 1, at West Plateau, on the cities' level 1 quest: a piece of equipment fetched from a merchant and shown to the giver. Finishing it finishes the character's own city class quest of level 1 too (the classquest event), so its guildmaster on the mainland goes on from where the homeland left off. Written by tools/quests/gen_homelands.py from tools/quests/homelands/hillgiant.json: change that file, never this quest's rows by hand.

quests.name: A Stone That Comes Back
quests.offer:
Giants fall. It is loud, and it hurts. Go to Spiritmaster Ognarr. He will tie your spirit to the camp, so you get up here after.
Then tell Coachman Durgo your name for his ledger. His coach goes to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands. It is a strong coach.
Will you see them both and come back?
quests.declined: Then do not fall down.
quests.started: Ognarr is north. Durgo is south, out on the plain.

steps.journal: Have Spiritmaster Ognarr, north of the elder, bind your spirit to the camp.
steps.says: Done. Fall where you like. You will get up here. Now go and tell Coachman Durgo your name.

steps.journal: Give your name to Coachman Durgo, on the plain south of the elder, for his ledger.
steps.says: A giant! Good. I built the coach for giants. It runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for those whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Hrolmog.
steps.says:
Good. Now you always come back.
Durgo's coach goes where its ledgers know you. But the stone way to Oggok is earned. Stonehand Borrik, beside me, has work for you.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests): the hillgiant's level 2, at West Plateau, on the cities' level 2 quest: the spiritmaster's bind and the coachman's ledger. Finishing it finishes the character's own city class quest of level 2 too (the classquest event), so its guildmaster on the mainland goes on from where the homeland left off. quests.name: Skinks in the Grass
quests.offer:
You are the new one. Good. Skinks are in the grass west of camp. They bite ankles. Giants have a lot of ankle.
Stamp on some. Bring me three of their scales. Then I will show you a thing.
Will you hunt them?
quests.declined: Then mind your ankles.
quests.started: Three scales. West, out on the plain.

steps.journal: Take three plateau skink scales from the plateau skinks on the plain west of the camp.
Bring three plateau skink scales to Stonehand Borrik.
steps.says: Three scales. Ankles still on. Good. Now watch my hands, and learn this.

quests.name: A Young Giant's Arms
quests.offer:
Fists are good. Fists with something in them are better. I will make you proper gear. You fetch what I need.
Hidewife Marna has leather and a shaft for me. Then take a claw off the rock badgers on the plain south of camp.
Will you bring me all three?
quests.declined: Then use your fists. They are not bad.
quests.started: Leather and a shaft from Marna. A claw from the badgers. Go.

steps.journal: Ask Hidewife Marna for the leather strip and the wooden shaft.
steps.says: For Borrik? Here. Hide, and a shaft. It was a tree this morning. Tell him to make it a big one.

steps.journal: Take a rock badger claw from the rock badgers on the plain south of the camp.
Bring the leather strip, the wooden shaft and the rock badger claw to Stonehand Borrik.
steps.says: All three. Stand back. This is loud... there. It is yours. Do not drop it on anyone you like.

quests.name: Old Greyjaw
quests.offer:
One more thing. An old wolf, Greyjaw, hunts far to the north, past Thundrik's stones. It took a calf from the herders. It is not afraid of giants.
It will come at you first. Let it. Then hit it. Bring me its fang.
Will you hunt Greyjaw?
quests.declined: It is old. It is not getting slower.
quests.started: North. Past Thundrik and his stones, and on. It will find you.

steps.journal: Take Greyjaw's fang from the old wolf Greyjaw, far north of the camp, beyond the gatekeeper.
Bring Greyjaw's fang to Stonehand Borrik.
steps.says:
Greyjaw's fang. Hah! The herders will sleep. You are not so small now.
Learn this. Then see Gatekeeper Thundrik at the stones to the north when you want Oggok.

quests.name: The Stone Way
quests.offer:
The ogres of Oggok are strong, and they like giants. They will train you as one of their own, across the sea.
You have earned the stone way. I will set you down among your own guild in Oggok, and your spirit will rest there.
Shall I open the way to Oggok?
quests.declined: The way will keep. Stone does.
quests.started: Stand still and hold your breath. Walk tall in Oggok!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Thundrik when you are ready to go to Oggok.

quests.notes: Ours: the gatekeeper's port to Oggok, the hillgiant's wire race's city, each class to its own guild's spot there (teleport to mainland: the wire race's start row for the class), bound there: the passage the five starter quests earn (a coach runs between the home and Freeport for anyone). quests.name: Pelts for Marna
quests.offer:
You are bigger now. Good. Marna wants pelts for the cold months. Our plateau has no snow. The Goldfeather Eyrie has lots.
Ride Durgo's coach to the Eyrie outpost. Badgers live on the snow east of it. Bring me three pelts.
Will you hunt badgers for Marna?
quests.declined: Then Marna is cold. She will tell you about it.
quests.started: Three pelts. Not torn. Marna is fussy.

steps.journal: Take three snowfield badger pelts from the badgers on the snow east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the three snowfield badger pelts to Stonehand Borrik.
steps.says: Three. Good thick ones. Marna will stop shouting. Now watch my hands, and learn this.

quests.name: A Bigger Thing to Hit With
quests.offer:
You grew. Your arms did not. I will make you a bigger thing to hit with.
The quartermaster at the Eyrie outpost has ore. Marna has leather. Then bring one skein of silk off the rime spiders north-east of the outpost, to wrap the grip.
Will you bring me ore, leather and silk?
quests.declined: Then hit things with the small one.
quests.started: Ore, leather, silk. Three things. Count on your fingers.

steps.journal: Ask Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost for the ore Borrik wants.
steps.says: Borrik's? He sent word by the coach: "big ore." Here, the biggest I have. Mind your feet when you carry it.

steps.journal: Ask Hidewife Marna for a leather strip.
steps.says: For Borrik's grip? Here. Badger leather, from your pelts. See? Nothing wasted.

steps.journal: Take a skein of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the iron ore, the leather strip and the rime spider silk to Stonehand Borrik.
steps.says: All three. Stand back. This is louder than last time... there. It is yours. It is big. Good.

quests.name: Frostjaw
quests.offer:
Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost is a giant. Our blood. He sent word. An old snow leopard, Frostjaw, eats his hunters on the slopes north-east of the outpost.
Halvek cannot leave the outpost. You can. Kill Frostjaw. Take friends. Leopards are fast. Giants are not.
Will you kill Old Frostjaw?
quests.declined: Then Halvek loses more hunters.
quests.started: Hit him hard. Then hit him again.

steps.journal: Kill Old Frostjaw on the slopes north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
Return to Stonehand Borrik.
steps.says: Frostjaw is dead? Hah! Halvek will drink to you. So will I. Learn this.

quests.name: Ice for Halvek
quests.offer:
Halvek sent word again. Something cold walks the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost. The Rimeheart. It makes the snow too cold even for giants.
Break it. Take a piece to Halvek, so he knows. Then come back.
Will you break the Rimeheart?
quests.declined: Then Halvek stays cold.
quests.started: Do not go alone. Even giants do not go alone.

steps.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: A giant of the plateau broke the Rimeheart? Good blood. Tell Borrik the Eyrie owes the camp a feast.

steps.journal: Return to Stonehand Borrik.
steps.says: Halvek's word came on the coach. A feast! You are a real giant now. Learn this.

quests.name: Standing with Halvek
quests.offer:
Hmm. Borrik says you are grown. A grown giant stands with its kin once. Halvek is our kin. He keeps the outpost at the Goldfeather Eyrie.
Go. Stand with him. Do what he asks. Then come home, and choose your road.
Will you stand with Halvek?
quests.declined: Then grow a little more.
quests.started: Go. Walk tall.

steps.journal: Find Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: Hrolmog sends a giant! Good. The Goldfeather raiders mock my sentries from their eyrie. Bring me three of their war-talons.

steps.journal: Take three war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the three war-talons to Warden Halvek.
steps.says: Three talons! They will not mock us now. Go home, kin. Tell Hrolmog you stood well.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Hrolmog in the giants' camp.
steps.says: Halvek's word came first. You stood well. You are not small now. The camp has one more thing for you.

quests.offer:
Mrrr. A new cub, with its eyes barely open. Come, let me look at you. Yes. You will do.
Every cub of the isle wears a claw band, woven of palm and its mother's fur, until its first hunt. Weaver Shimra makes them, under the first stilt house to the north-east.
Will you fetch your claw band and show it to me?
quests.declined: Then curl up in the sun a while. I often do.
quests.started: Shimra sits under the first stilt house, north-east of here.

steps.journal: Ask Weaver Shimra, under the stilt house north-east of Elder Ssharu, for a cub's claw band.
steps.says: The elder's new cub? Paw out. Claws in, please. There: palm for the island, fur for the pride. A cub pays nothing.

steps.journal: Show the cub's claw band to Elder Ssharu.
steps.says: It suits you. Wear it, and every kerran on the isle will know whose cub you are.

quests.name: Nine Lives, One Home
quests.offer:
They say a kerran has nine lives. Do not count on it. Have Spiritmaster Talhrin bind your spirit to the isle, so that you wake here whichever life you lose.
Then give your name to Coachman Tolhra for his ledger. His coach, and the ferry that carries it, runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
quests.declined: Then keep out of the deep water until you do.
quests.started: Talhrin is across the village, to the east. Tolhra waits a few steps north of here.

steps.journal: Have Spiritmaster Talhrin, east of the elder, bind your spirit to the isle.
steps.says: It is done. Lose a life where you will, cub, and you will wake here in the sun. Now go and give Coachman Tolhra your name.

steps.journal: Give your name to Coachman Tolhra, a few steps north of the elder, for his ledger.
steps.says: A cub off the isle at last! My coach rides the ferry over, then runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for those whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Ssharu.
steps.says:
Good. Now the isle will always have you back.
Tolhra's coach goes where its ledgers know you, but the crossing to Qeynos is earned. Huntress Kazhra, beside me, has work for you.

steps.says: All three. Sit a moment while I work... there. It is yours. Keep it as sharp as your claws.

quests.name: A Charm for the Shell
quests.offer:
Another young one, fresh from the egg and still soft in the shell! Every kappa of the Dwell wears a shell charm before it first leaves the island.
Netmender Ishiko strings them from river shell and reed cord. She mends her nets on the sand just west of here.
Will you fetch your charm and show it to me?
quests.declined: The Dwell will wait for you.
quests.started: Go on, then. Ishiko is on the sand just west of here.

steps.journal: Ask Netmender Ishiko, west of Elder Hoshuk, for a river-shell charm.
steps.says: The elder sent you? Bend your neck. There: river shell for a hard back, reed cord so the water does not take it. No charge for a young one.

steps.journal: Show the river-shell charm to Elder Hoshuk.
steps.says: It hangs well on you. Wear it, and the river will know you for one of ours.

quests.name: Bound to the Dwell
quests.offer:
The water carries young ones far, and it does not always carry them back. Have Spiritmaster Oruko bind your spirit to the Dwell, so that you wake here if you fall.
Then give your name to Coachman Dobu for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
quests.declined: Then wade in the shallows until you do.
quests.started: Oruko stands on the west sand, past Ishiko. Dobu keeps his coach on the sand south of here.

steps.journal: Have Spiritmaster Oruko, on the sand west of the elder, bind your spirit to the Dwell.
steps.says: It is done. Should you fall, you will wake here on our sand. Now go and give Coachman Dobu your name.

steps.journal: Give your name to Coachman Dobu, south of the elder, for his ledger.
steps.says: Welcome to my stable, young one. My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Hoshuk.
steps.says:
Good. Now the Dwell will always draw you home, as the sea draws the river.
Dobu's coach will carry you to Freeport if its ledger knows you, but the way down the river to Rivervale is earned. Reedwarden Tsumo, beside me, has work for you.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests): the kappa's level 2, at Sylhilthis' Dwell, on the cities' level 2 quest: the spiritmaster's bind and the coachman's ledger. quests.name: Rats in the Reeds
quests.offer:
So you are the young one Hoshuk spoke of. Good. Marsh rats have dug into the reeds where our causeway meets the shore, and they gnaw the nets we dry there.
Cross the causeway to the south-east and bring me three of their tails. Then I will teach you something worth knowing.
Will you hunt them?
quests.declined: Then the nets will be gnawed to string.
quests.started: Three tails. Keep your shell between you and their teeth.

steps.journal: Take three marsh rat tails from the marsh rats on the shore south-east of the Dwell, where the causeway lands.
Bring three marsh rat tails to Reedwarden Tsumo.
steps.says: Three tails, and not a crack in your shell. You can fight. Now watch closely, and learn this.

quests.name: A Young One's Arms
quests.offer:
Bare claws will not serve you down the river. I will make you proper gear, but you will fetch what I need.
Netmender Ishiko has reed cord and a good shaft for me. Then take a scale from the mudfang basilisks on the flats south of the shore, past the rats.
Will you bring me all three?
quests.declined: Then keep to your claws, and to the shallows.
quests.started: Cord and a shaft from Ishiko, a scale from the mudfangs. Go.

steps.journal: Ask Netmender Ishiko for the braided reed cord and the wooden shaft.
steps.says: For Tsumo? Here, a braid of reed cord and a straight shaft. Tell him the nets come first next time.

steps.journal: Take a mudfang scale from the mudfang basilisks on the flats south of the Dwell, past the marsh rats.
Bring the braided reed cord, the wooden shaft and the mudfang scale to Reedwarden Tsumo.
steps.says: All three. Give me a moment... there. It is yours: carry it well.

quests.name: Old Gulpjaw
quests.offer:
One task more before the river takes you. A great blue basilisk we call Gulpjaw has dragged two of our netmenders off the east shore.
He lies alone on the bank east of where the causeway lands, and he bites first. Bring me his tooth, and I will teach you the last thing I have for a young one.
Will you hunt Gulpjaw?
quests.declined: He will not grow gentler while you wait.
quests.started: Over the causeway, then east along the shore. Do not let him get his jaws on your shell.

steps.journal: Take Gulpjaw's tooth from the blue basilisk Gulpjaw on the shore south-east of the Dwell, east of the causeway.
Bring Gulpjaw's tooth to Reedwarden Tsumo.
steps.says:
Gulpjaw's own tooth! The netmenders will work the east shore again. You are a young one no longer.
Learn this, and see Gatekeeper Kabbo on the causeway when you are ready to go down the river.

quests.name: Two Tasks Upriver

You have grown into your shell. Good. The rivers of the Homelands all run from the cold, and at the Goldfeather Eyrie the Homelands keep a hunters' outpost on the frozen river.
Ride Dobu's coach there. Bring me three clumps of drift rat fur and a badger's pelt, from the snow east of the outpost. The netmenders want them for the winter.
Will you go up to the ice?

quests.started: Keep your shell dry. Cold water is slow to forgive.

steps.journal: Take three clumps of drift rat fur from the drift rats east of the Eyrie outpost.
Take a snowfield badger pelt from the badgers on the snow east of the Eyrie outpost.

steps.says: Fur and a pelt, and not a crack in your shell. The netmenders will be warm. Now watch closely, and learn this.

quests.name: Ore from the Eyrie

River clay makes a fine pot and a poor blade. You need better arms now, and the Eyrie outpost has the ore for it.
Ask Quartermaster Dunmore there for ore, and Ishiko here for her reed cord. Then a skein of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the outpost, to bind it.
Will you bring me all three?
quests.declined: Then keep your old arms oiled.
quests.started: Ore, cord and silk. Mind the river ice.

steps.journal: Ask Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost for ore for Tsumo.
steps.says: Tsumo's word came by the coach. Here, good ore. Do not let it fall through the ice: I will not fish for it.

steps.journal: Ask Netmender Ishiko for braided reed cord.
steps.says: More cord for Tsumo? Here. He will owe me a net by the end of this.

steps.journal: Take a skein of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

steps.says: All three. Give me a moment... there. It is yours. Better than river clay, I promise you.

Will you hunt the frostpaw cubs?

steps.journal: Kill four frostpaw cubs on the snow north of the Eyrie outpost.

quests.name: The Cold at the River's Source
quests.offer:
The water at the Dwell has run colder all season. It comes from the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost, where a thing the hunters call the Rimeheart walks.
Break it, and bring me a shard. I would see what has chilled our river.
Will you face the Rimeheart?
quests.declined: Then the river runs colder.
quests.started: Go with others. That cold cracks shells.

steps.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

steps.says: So this is what chilled the river. It will warm now. You are no young one, %p. Learn this.

quests.name: Up the River and Home
quests.offer:
Tsumo says your shell has hardened. A kappa of the Dwell goes once to the head of the river, and helps whoever keeps it, before it goes down to the sea.
Go to Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost, and do as he asks. Then come home to me, and choose your path.
Will you go up the river?
quests.declined: The river runs all year. Go when you are ready.
quests.started: Swim well, and come home.

steps.journal: Find Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: Hoshuk sends a kappa? Good. The Goldfeather raiders robbed Dunmore's stores again. Ask him what they took.

steps.journal: Ask Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost what the raiders took.
steps.says: Half my winter stores, gone up to their eyrie. I want their war-talons, two of them, so they know we can reach them.

steps.journal: Take two war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the two war-talons to Quartermaster Dunmore.
steps.says: Two talons! I'll hang them over my stores. Go home, kappa. Tell Hoshuk the outpost owes the Dwell.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Hoshuk at the Dwell.
steps.says: You went up the river and came down it again. That is the whole of a kappa's life, done young. The Dwell has one more gift.

quests.name: A Ring from the Tide Line
quests.offer:
Hss, a new whisker in the camp, and nothing shiny on it yet! Every ratman of the Deep wears a tideline ring, twisted from the first good wire the sea gave us.
Ragpicker Tikka sorts what the tide leaves. Her heap is on the sand north of here.
Will you fetch your ring and show it to me?
quests.declined: The camp will wait, whisker.
quests.started: Go. Tikka's heap is on the sand north of here.

steps.journal: Ask Ragpicker Tikka, north of Elder Skritch, for a tideline ring.
steps.says: Skritch sent you? Hold out a claw. There: good wire, twisted tight, and it is the only thing in this heap you get for nothing.

steps.journal: Show the tideline ring to Elder Skritch.
steps.says: Shiny enough. Wear it, and the camp will know you did not steal your place here.

quests.name: Bound to the Shore
quests.offer:
The tide takes the slow, whisker, and the deep tunnels take the rest. Have Spiritmaster Vessik bind your spirit to the camp, so that you wake here when something eats you.
Then give your name to Coachman Rusk for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
quests.declined: Then stay where I can see you.
quests.started: Vessik is north-west of here, by the shacks. Rusk keeps his coach on the open sand to the south-east.

steps.journal: Have Spiritmaster Vessik, north-west of the elder, bind your spirit to the shore camp.
steps.says: It is done. When something eats you, you will wake here in the camp. Now go and give Coachman Rusk your name.

steps.journal: Give your name to Coachman Rusk, south-east of the elder, for his ledger.
steps.says: Welcome to my stable, whisker. My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Skritch.
steps.says:
Good. Now you cannot get lost, however hard you try.
Rusk's coach will carry you to Freeport if its ledger knows you, but the way down to Moradhim is earned. Tunnelrunner Chisk, beside me, has work for you.

quests.name: Snakes on the Shore
quests.offer:
So you are the new whisker. Good. Dune snakes come down the sand east of the camp and swallow our eggs whole.
Kill them and bring me three of their fangs. Then I will teach you something worth knowing.
Will you hunt them?
quests.declined: Then hide the eggs well.
quests.started: Three fangs. Strike first, whisker.

steps.journal: Take three dune snake fangs from the dune snakes on the sand east of the camp.

Chisk says you run like a tunnelrunner now. Before a ratman of the Deep chooses its path, it brings the camp something the other homes will owe us for.
Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost pays a bounty on the Goldfeather raiders. Find him, earn it, and come back to me.
Will you earn Dunmore's bounty?
quests.declined: Then someone else will be paid. Hss.
quests.started: Come back richer, whisker.

steps.journal: Find Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: Skritch sent you? Good. The raiders round the eyrie east of here have robbed my stores twice this month. Three of their war-talons, and the bounty is yours.

steps.journal: Take three war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the three war-talons to Quartermaster Dunmore.
steps.says: Three talons, as promised. The bounty goes to your camp on Rusk's coach, every coin. Go on home: your elder will want to count it.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Skritch at the shore camp.
steps.says: Dunmore's coin came, and the Eyrie owes the Deep. You went out a whisker and came back a ratman the homes know. Now choose your path.

quests.name: A Reveler's Bangle
quests.offer:
A new voice for the glade, and not a thing on you that rattles! Every satyr of these woods wears a bangle of vine-wood, so the dance can hear it coming.
Reedcutter Syla carves them between songs. You will find her a few steps south-east of here.
Will you fetch your bangle and show it to me?
quests.declined: The glade will wait for your song.
quests.started: Off you skip, then. Syla is just south-east of here.

steps.journal: Ask Reedcutter Syla, south-east of Elder Pannoch, for a reveler's bangle.
steps.says: Pannoch sent you? Give me your wrist. There: vine-wood, so it sings when you dance. I take no coin from a kid, only a tune some day.

steps.journal: Show the reveler's bangle to Elder Pannoch.
steps.says: Ha! Hear it click. Wear it, and the glade will never lose you in the dance.

quests.name: Bound to the Glade
quests.offer:
A dance can carry a kid far from home, and the woods are not always kind. Have Spiritmaster Corvann bind your spirit to the glade, so that you wake here if you fall.
Then give your name to Coachman Brannoc for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
quests.declined: Then dance close to the fire until you do.
quests.started: Corvann stands just north of here. Brannoc keeps his coach on the grass to the east.

steps.journal: Have Spiritmaster Corvann, north of the elder, bind your spirit to the glade.
steps.says: It is done. Should you fall, you will wake here among the pipes. Now go and give Coachman Brannoc your name.

steps.journal: Give your name to Coachman Brannoc, east of the elder, for his ledger.
steps.says: Welcome to my stable, kid. My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Pannoch.
steps.says:
Good! Now every road you dance down leads back to us.
Brannoc's coach will carry you to Freeport if its ledger knows you, but the elven road is earned. Hornwarden Tavos, beside me, has work for you.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests): the satyr's level 2, at East Toxxulia, on the cities' level 2 quest: the spiritmaster's bind and the coachman's ledger. quests.name: Webs on the Dancing Paths
quests.offer:
So you are the new kid. Good. Glade spiderlings are spinning their webs across our dancing paths, on the grass east of the glade.
Clear them out and bring me three of their legs. Then I will teach you something worth knowing.
Will you hunt them?
quests.declined: Then we dance around the webs.
quests.started: Three legs. Mind the webs!

steps.journal: Take three glade spiderling legs from the glade spiderlings on the grass east of the glade.

steps.says: Three legs, and no web in your fur. You can fight. Now watch my hooves, and learn this.

quests.name: A Kid's Arms
quests.offer:
Stubby horns will not serve you on the elven road. I will make you proper gear, but you will fetch what I need.
Reedcutter Syla has vine cord and a good shaft for me. Then take a stinger from the mead wasps that swarm south-east of the glade.
Will you bring me all three?
quests.declined: Then keep to your horns, and to the fire.
quests.started: Cord and a shaft from Syla, a stinger from the wasps. Go.

steps.journal: Ask Reedcutter Syla for the twisted vine cord and the wooden shaft.
steps.says: For Tavos? Here, a twist of vine cord and a straight shaft. Tell him he still owes me a dance.

steps.journal: Take a mead wasp stinger from the mead wasps south-east of the glade.
Bring the twisted vine cord, the wooden shaft and the mead wasp stinger to Hornwarden Tavos.
steps.says: All three. Give me a moment... there. It is yours: carry it lightly.

quests.name: Nightpelt
quests.offer:
One task more before the road. A shadow panther we call Nightpelt has taken two pipers from the hollow at the south end of the woods.
She hunts alone down there, and she springs first. Bring me her fang, and I will teach you the last thing I have for a kid.
Will you hunt Nightpelt?
quests.declined: She will not grow gentler while you wait.
quests.started: South, past the sentinel on the path, and down into the hollow. Do not let her get behind you.

steps.journal: Take Nightpelt's fang from the shadow panther Nightpelt in the hollow south of the glade.
Bring Nightpelt's fang to Hornwarden Tavos.
steps.says:
Nightpelt's own fang! The pipers will play in the hollow again. You are a kid no longer.
Learn this, and see Gatekeeper Dorvan when you are ready for the elven road.

quests.name: The Elven Road
quests.offer:
The road to Tunaria is open. The elves of Tethelin and Fayspire share our love of the old woods, and they will train you as their own, each in the city of your calling.
You have earned the passage, kid. I will set you down among your own guild in the elves' city, and your spirit will rest there.
Shall I send you down the elven road?
quests.declined: The road will wait for you.
quests.started: Go with a light step!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Dorvan when you are ready to take the elven road to the elves' cities.

quests.name: Drumheads for the Glade
quests.offer:
Our dances need drums, kid, and the best drumheads are thick hides from cold country. The homes keep a hunters' outpost under the Goldfeather Eyrie, and Brannoc's coach runs there.
Bring me two snowfield badger pelts from the snow east of the outpost, and the glade will dance to them all winter.
Will you hunt the badgers?
quests.declined: Then we dance to the old drums a while longer.
quests.started: Brannoc's coach will take you. Mind your hooves on the ice!

steps.journal: Take two snowfield badger pelts from the badgers on the snow east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the two badger pelts to Hornwarden Tavos.
steps.says: Thick as bark, and not a hole in them! Listen... a good drum, and a good hunter. Now watch my hooves, and learn this.

quests.name: Feathers for Luck
quests.offer:
You have outgrown the arms I made you, kid. I will make you better ones, and a hornwarden's weapon is trimmed with owl feathers for luck.
Get a straight shaft from Reedcutter Syla. Then bring me three feathers from the pale owls north of the Eyrie outpost.
Will you bring me the shaft and the feathers?
quests.declined: Then dance carefully with what you have.
quests.started: Syla first, then the owls. Off you go!

steps.journal: Ask Reedcutter Syla in the glade for a wooden shaft.

steps.journal: Take three pale owl feathers from the pale owls north of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the wooden shaft and the pale owl feathers to Hornwarden Tavos.
steps.says: Light as a song. A moment... there. It is yours: swing it the way you dance.

quests.name: Masks for the Revel
quests.offer:
The glade holds a winter revel, kid, and the dancers wear masks trimmed with frostpaw fur. The cubs are thick on the snow north of the Eyrie outpost this year.
The outpost's hunters say there are too many of them anyway. Bring me three tufts, and I will teach you what a hornwarden knows.
Will you bring me three frostpaw tufts?
quests.declined: Then the dancers go bare-faced. A shame.
quests.started: Past the river, north. Their mothers are not far, so be quick!

steps.journal: Take three frostpaw tufts from the frostpaw cubs north of the Eyrie outpost, past the river.
Bring three frostpaw tufts to Hornwarden Tavos.
steps.says: Soft as a lullaby! The revel will have its masks. Learn this, and come and dance with us.

quests.name: Tavos's Wager
quests.offer:
I have a wager with Scout Feyla at the Eyrie: that a satyr of the glade could break the Rimeheart, the cold thing in the ice caves north-east of the outpost.
Win me my wager, kid. Break it, show Feyla a shard of it, then come back and tell me how she took it.
Will you win me my wager?
quests.declined: Then I had better not bet the glade's pipes.
quests.started: Take friends. A wager is no good to a dead satyr.

steps.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
Show the shard of the Rimeheart to Scout Feyla on the frozen river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: That is a shard of the Rimeheart, all right. Tavos wins his wager, curse him. Tell him I will pay at his next revel.

steps.journal: Return to Hornwarden Tavos.
steps.says: She paid? Ha! She will. You have won me a wager and the snow its game back. Learn this.

quests.name: Silence the Horns
quests.offer:
Tavos says you dance and fight like a hornwarden. Before a satyr of the glade chooses its path, it plays its part for the homes we share the snow with.
The Goldfeather raiders blow war-horns before every raid on the river. Ask Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost what he needs, then come back to me.

quests.declined: The horns will still be blowing when you are ready.
quests.started: Go with a light step, and come home with a song.

steps.journal: Find Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: Pannoch's kid? Good. The raiders gather at their horns' call, round the eyrie east of here. Bring me two of their war-horns, and the river will be quiet.

steps.journal: Take two war-horns from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the two war-horns to Warden Halvek.
steps.says: Two horns. Without them the raiders come in ones and twos, and those we can handle. Go home: your elder will want to hear it.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Pannoch in the glade.
steps.says: You went out a kid and came back with a song every home will sing. There is one more thing the glade gives its own.

Tavos says you dance and fight like a hornwarden. Before a satyr of the glade chooses its path, it plays its part for the homes we share the snow with.
The Goldfeather raiders blow war-horns before every raid on the river. Ask Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost what he needs, then come back to me.
Will you go to the warden?
quests.declined: The horns will still be blowing when you are ready.
quests.started: Go with a light step, and come home with a song.

steps.journal: Find Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: Pannoch's kid? Good. The raiders gather at their horns' call, round the eyrie east of here. Bring me two of their war-horns, and the river will be quiet.

steps.journal: Take two war-horns from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the two war-horns to Warden Halvek.
steps.says: Two horns. Without them the raiders come in ones and twos, and those we can handle. Go home: your elder will want to hear it.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Pannoch in the glade.
steps.says: You went out a kid and came back with a song every home will sing. There is one more thing the glade gives its own.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' chain past the flight): the satyr's level 20 for the shadowknight, at East Toxxulia, on the cities' level 20 quest: a road of errands ending at the giver, who asks which path the character takes, the options its class's city asks ("Which do you take?"). Finishing it finishes the character's own city class quest of level 20 too (the classquest event), so its guildmaster on the mainland goes on from where the homeland left off. quests.name: An Acorn for the Ear
quests.offer:
A new leaf on the old tree! Every dryad of the grove wears an acorn cap at her ear, from the oak that first sheltered us, so the forest knows her voice.
Weaver Fernlight keeps them. She sits by the water a few steps south of here.
Will you fetch your acorn cap and show it to me?
quests.declined: The grove is patient, little leaf.
quests.started: Go, then. Fernlight is by the water, just south of here.

steps.journal: Ask Weaver Fernlight, south of Elder Silverbough, for an acorn-cap earring.
steps.says: Silverbough sent you? Turn your head, little leaf. There: a cap from the first oak. The grove asks nothing for it but that you come back.

steps.journal: Show the acorn-cap earring to Elder Silverbough.
steps.says: It suits you. Wear it, and the old trees will know your step wherever you walk.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests): the dryad's level 1, at West Toxxulia, on the cities' level 1 quest: a piece of equipment fetched from a merchant and shown to the giver. quests.name: Rooted in the Grove
quests.offer:
The wind carries young leaves far, and not all of them land softly. Have Spiritmaster Ashleaf bind your spirit to the grove, so that you wake here if you fall.
Then give your name to Coachman Thistlewick for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
quests.declined: Then stay under the branches until you do.
quests.started: Both are north along the shore: Thistlewick the satyr first, Ashleaf a little past him.

steps.journal: Have Spiritmaster Ashleaf, north of the elder along the shore, bind your spirit to the grove.
steps.says: It is done. Should you fall, you will wake here under our branches. Now go and give Coachman Thistlewick your name.

steps.journal: Give your name to Coachman Thistlewick, on the shore north of the elder, for his ledger.
steps.says: Welcome to my stable, little leaf. My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Silverbough.
steps.says:
Good. Now your roots are here, however far your branches reach.
Thistlewick's coach will carry you to Freeport if its ledger knows you, but the way west to Qeynos is earned. Thornwarden Briony, beside me, has work for you.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests): the dryad's level 2, at West Toxxulia, on the cities' level 2 quest: the spiritmaster's bind and the coachman's ledger. quests.name: Beetles in the Bark
quests.offer:
So you are the new leaf. Good. Bark beetles are boring into the old trees in the woods west of the lake, and the trees are sickening.
Stop them and bring me three of their shells. Then I will teach you something worth knowing.
Will you hunt them?
quests.declined: Then the old trees will suffer.
quests.started: Three shells. The trees will thank you.

steps.journal: Take three bark beetle shells from the bark beetles in the woods west of the lake.
Bring three bark beetle shells to Thornwarden Briony.
steps.says: Three shells, and not a leaf out of place. You can fight. Now watch closely, and learn this.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests): the dryad's level 3, at West Toxxulia, on the cities' level 3 quest: a hunt for drops; each class is taught what its own city's level 3 quest teaches it. quests.name: A Sapling's Arms
quests.offer:
Soft bark will not serve you among the humans. I will make you proper gear, but you will fetch what I need.
Weaver Fernlight has bark cord and a shaft of deadfall for me. Then take a skin from the rootcoil snakes deeper in the woods to the west, past the beetles.
Will you bring me all three?
quests.declined: Then keep to the grove, and to its shade.
quests.started: Cord and a shaft from Fernlight, a skin from the snakes. Go.

steps.journal: Ask Weaver Fernlight for the willow-bark cord and the wooden shaft.
steps.says: For Briony? Here, a cord of willow bark and a shaft of deadfall. No living branch was cut for it: tell her so.

steps.journal: Take a rootcoil snake skin from the rootcoil snakes deep in the woods west of the lake, past the beetles.
Bring the willow-bark cord, the wooden shaft and the rootcoil snake skin to Thornwarden Briony.
steps.says: All three. Give me a moment... there. It is yours: let it serve the forest.

quests.name: Rotbark
quests.offer:
One task more before you go west. A shambler of the forest has gone to rot at the far west edge of the woods. We call it Rotbark, and what it touches withers.
It stands alone there, past the snakes, and it strikes at anything that walks. Bring me its heartwood, and I will teach you the last thing I have for a sapling.
Will you hunt Rotbark?
quests.declined: The rot will not wait as you do.
quests.started: West through the woods, past the beetles and the snakes. Do not let it take hold of you.

steps.journal: Take Rotbark's heartwood from the rotting shambler Rotbark at the far west edge of the woods.
Bring Rotbark's heartwood to Thornwarden Briony.
steps.says:
Rotbark's heartwood... The woods can heal now. You are a sapling no longer.

The way to Tunaria is open. The humans of Qeynos guard the groves of Surefall Glade, where our rangers and druids go; the rest of us train in Qeynos itself.
You have earned the passage, sapling. I will set you down among your own guild there, and your spirit will rest there.

quests.name: The Pines of the Eyrie
quests.offer:
The homes keep a hunters' outpost under the Goldfeather Eyrie, and the few pines round it are dying. Drift rats gnaw their bark, and badgers dig out their roots.
Ride Thistlewick's coach there. Bring me two drift rat teeth and a badger's claw from the snow east of the outpost, so the pines can rest.

quests.declined: The pines will wait as long as they can.
quests.started: Thistlewick's coach will take you. Wrap up, little leaf: it is cold.

quests.offer:
You have grown past a sapling's arms. I will make you a thornwarden's weapon, bound with silk that does not rot in rain or snow.

steps.journal: Ask Weaver Fernlight in the grove for willow-bark cord.

quests.name: The Balance of the Snow
quests.offer:
An old snow leopard they call Old Frostjaw hunts the slopes north-east of the Eyrie outpost. He kills more than he can eat, and the snow is emptying of game.
A forest is kept by taking what is out of balance. Bring him down, and I will teach you what a thornwarden knows. Take friends.

quests.started: He strikes first. Let the others draw him, and strike when he turns.

steps.says: He is gone? Then the game will come back to the slopes, and the hunters will eat. That is balance. Learn this.

quests.name: A Seed of Ice
quests.offer:
The Rimeheart walks the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost, and where it walks nothing grows. The elder wants it broken, and a piece of it brought here.
We will bury the shard under the old oak. Even ice that never melts gives way to roots in time.
Will you bring me a shard of the Rimeheart?
quests.declined: Then the caves stay barren a while longer.

steps.says: So cold, even now. The oak will have it, and a hundred springs will soften it. You have done the grove proud. Learn this.

quests.name: The Last Pines
quests.offer:
Briony says your roots are deep now. Before a dryad of the grove chooses her path, she does a kindness for the homes we share the land with.
Spiritmaster Oswin at the Eyrie outpost sent word on the wind: the raiders are cutting the last pines. Go to him, then come home to me.
Will you go to Oswin?
quests.declined: The pines cannot wait forever, little leaf.
quests.started: Grow tall, and come home.

steps.journal: Find Spiritmaster Oswin at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: Silverbough's word reached you? Good. The Goldfeather raiders cut the pines for their fires. Warden Halvek means to stop them: go to him.

steps.journal: Find Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: Oswin sent you. The raiders round the eyrie east of here carry war-talons. Bring me three, and they will learn the pines are guarded.

steps.journal: Take three war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the three war-talons to Warden Halvek.
steps.says: Three talons. The pines will stand another winter. Go home to your grove: your elder will want to hear it from you.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Silverbough in the grove.
steps.says: You left a sapling and came back with branches that shelter other homes. The grove has one more thing to give you.

quests.name: A Novice's Prayer Beads
quests.offer:
Be still. Good. You have come out of the long quiet and into the noise of the world. It will pass. Everything loud does.
Each novice of the order counts its breaths on a string of temple beads. Artificer Maelis strings them, a few steps north of here.
Will you fetch your beads and show them to me?
quests.declined: Then wait. Waiting, too, is practice.
quests.started: Maelis is a few steps to the north, on the road's far side.

steps.journal: Ask Artificer Maelis, a few steps north of Elder Ithrael, for a novice's prayer beads.
steps.says: A novice. Hold out your hand. One bead for each breath, and when the string ends, begin again. The order asks no coin of its own.

steps.journal: Show the novice's prayer beads to Elder Ithrael.
steps.says: Count on them when the world grows loud. It will. Now you are one of the order, and the order is quiet.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests): the jalraeth's level 1, at Envar, on the cities' level 1 quest: a piece of equipment fetched from a merchant and shown to the giver. Finishing it finishes the character's own city class quest of level 1 too (the classquest event), so its guildmaster on the mainland goes on from where the homeland left off. Written by tools/quests/gen_homelands.py from tools/quests/homelands/jalraeth.json: change that file, never this quest's rows by hand.

quests.name: Anchored at Envar
quests.offer:
A mind adrift is lost. Have Spiritmaster Oravai anchor your spirit at Envar, so that you return to this road if the world unmakes you.
Then give your name to Coachman Therun for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands.
Will you see them both and return to me?
quests.declined: Then go nowhere you cannot walk back from.
quests.started: Oravai waits to the south-west. Therun is a few steps behind you, by the road.

steps.journal: Have Spiritmaster Oravai, south-west of the elder, bind your spirit to Envar.
steps.says: It is done. Whatever unmakes you, you will gather again on this road. Now give Coachman Therun your name.

steps.journal: Give your name to Coachman Therun, by the road just east of the elder, for his ledger.
steps.says: A novice. My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for those whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now. I will not speak on the road. You will be glad of it.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Ithrael.
steps.says:
Good. Now you have a place to return to, and may go out from it.
Therun's coach goes where its ledgers know you, but the scholars' door is earned. Watcher Vaeris, a few steps south, has work for you.

quests.name: Grubs in the Dead Hills
quests.offer:
The novice. Good. Ash grubs breed in the dead hills east of the road, and they have begun to gnaw at the temple's stones.
Thin them, and bring me three of their teeth. Then I will show you a thing the order teaches.
Will you hunt them?
quests.declined: Stone is patient. It will be eaten slowly.
quests.started: Three teeth. East, where the road runs out into the hills.

steps.journal: Take three ash grub teeth from the ash grubs in the dead hills east of the road.
Bring three ash grub teeth to Watcher Vaeris.
steps.says: Three teeth. You did not hurry, and you did not falter. Now watch, and learn this.

quests.name: A Novice's Arms
quests.offer:
A still mind is not enough in the lands beyond. I will make you proper gear, but you will bring what it needs.
Artificer Maelis has cord and a shaft set aside. Then take a fang from the cinder adders on the low hills to the north-east.
Will you bring me all three?
quests.declined: Then go unarmed, and be very still indeed.
quests.started: Cord and a shaft from Maelis, a fang from the adders. Go.

steps.journal: Ask Artificer Maelis for the silk cord and the wooden shaft.
steps.says: For Vaeris. Here: cord, and a shaft cut straight. Use them once, and well.

steps.journal: Take a cinder adder fang from the cinder adders on the low hills north-east of the road.
Bring the silk cord, the wooden shaft and the cinder adder fang to Watcher Vaeris.
steps.says: All three. Be patient a moment... there. It is yours. Do not grow fond of it. It is a tool.

quests.name: The Hollow Pilgrim
quests.offer:
One task more. The temple's dead keep to the temple, but one has wandered out: a hollow thing in a pilgrim's rags, on the hill east of the grubs.

It rests, then. I will see the bone laid where it belongs. You are a novice no longer.

The scholars of Highbourne, on Tunaria's western shore, took in the first of us, eager for what we know. They will teach you in turn.
You have earned the door. I will set you down among your own guild in Highbourne, and your spirit will rest there.

quests.started: Drift well, and keep your mind still!

quests.name: Two Tasks in the Cold

The order sends its novices into the cold once, to learn that stillness is not sleep. The Homelands keep an outpost on the frozen river under the Goldfeather Eyrie.

quests.name: A Tool for the Road
quests.offer:
The tool I gave you served a novice. You need a better one. Do not grow fond of this one either.
Artificer Maelis has a shaft for me. Then take two skeins of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost, to bind it.

quests.name: Hunger in the Snow
quests.offer:
There is too much hunger on the snow north of the Eyrie outpost. The frostpaw cubs grow, and the snow's game thins, and the outpost's hunters go hungry.

Will you thin the frostpaw cubs?

quests.name: The Unmelting Shard
quests.offer:
Something in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost does not rest. The hunters call it the Rimeheart. It is old, and it is never still.
The order would study such a thing. Break it, and bring me a shard. Ice that does not melt has something to teach.

quests.declined: It will still be there. That is its trouble.
quests.started: Go with others. Stillness is not standing alone.

quests.name: The Vigil at the Eyrie
quests.offer:
Vaeris says you are a novice no longer. Each of the order keeps one vigil far from Envar, among other peoples, so that it learns its stillness is its own.
Sit with Spiritmaster Oswin at the Eyrie outpost, then go where Scout Feyla needs you. When it is done, return, and choose your path.
Will you keep the vigil?
quests.declined: A vigil kept too soon is only waiting.
quests.started: Be still. Then go.

steps.journal: Sit the vigil with Spiritmaster Oswin at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: A Jal'Raeth, come to sit with me? Sit, then. ... Good. The scout on the river has need of a steady hand. Go to Feyla.

steps.journal: Find Scout Feyla on the frozen river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: Oswin sent you? Then you will not panic. The Goldfeather raiders carry war-talons. Bring me three.

steps.journal: Take three war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the three war-talons to Scout Feyla.
steps.says: Three. And not a word wasted. Go home, quiet one. Your elder will want to hear it, though you will not say much.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Ithrael at Envar.
steps.says: The vigil is kept. You went out into the noise and came back still. The order has one more thing to give you.

quests.name: A Tunnel-Runner's Ear Ring
quests.offer:
A new one, yes? Hmm. Two ears, all your fingers. You will do. But no goblin of Moss Mouth runs the tunnels without the ear ring, or the lookouts take it for a thief.
Stitcher Nibb makes them, from rat bone and a bit of wire. Nibb sits across the hall, a few steps to the south-west.
Will you fetch your ear ring and show it to me?
quests.declined: Then stay where the lookouts can see you, little one.
quests.started: Go on, go on. Just across the hall. Nibb does not bite. Much.

steps.journal: Ask Stitcher Nibb, across the hall south-west of Elder Snikkit, for a tunnel-runner's ear ring.
steps.says: Snikkit sent you? Hold still. There: rat bone, good wire, hardly rusted. No charge for a new one. The next one costs you.

steps.journal: Show the tunnel-runner's ear ring to Elder Snikkit.
steps.says: Good, good. Now the lookouts will know you for one of ours. Do not lose it, little one.

quests.name: Bound to Moss Mouth
quests.offer:
A goblin who dies far from home is a goblin wasted. Have Spiritmaster Grizzik bind your spirit to the cavern, so that you wake here when something eats you.
Then put your mark in Coachman Rukkit's ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
quests.declined: Then try not to die, little one. It is harder than it sounds.
quests.started: Grizzik sits just south-east of here. Rukkit keeps his coach in the south chamber, down the passage.

steps.journal: Have Spiritmaster Grizzik, south-east of the elder, bind your spirit to Moss Mouth Cavern.
steps.says: There. The cavern has you now. Fall, and you wake here in the dark with the rest of us. Now go and make your mark for Coachman Rukkit.

steps.journal: Put your mark in Coachman Rukkit's ledger, in the south chamber down the passage from the hall.
steps.says: A new mark for the ledger! My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Snikkit.
steps.says:
Good. Now you cannot get lost, and you cannot stay dead. Both are useful.
Rukkit's coach will take you to Freeport if its ledger knows you, but the road to Neriak is earned. Pitmaster Grukk, beside me, has work for you.

quests.name: Rats in the Long Tunnel
quests.offer:
You are the new one? Hah. Small. The tunnel rats are breeding in the long tunnel again, and they chew every sack we carry in from the mouth.
Go west out of the hall, then south down the long tunnel to the mouth. Kill rats until you have three tails, and I will teach you a thing worth knowing.
Will you clear some rats?
quests.declined: Scared of rats? Neriak will eat you whole.
quests.started: Three tails. Not ears, not feet. Tails.

steps.journal: Take three tunnel rat tails from the tunnel rats in the long tunnel that runs south to the mouth.
Bring three tunnel rat tails to Pitmaster Grukk.
steps.says: Three tails, and you still have your own. Hah! Good. Now watch what I do, and learn this.

quests.name: A Goblin's Arms
quests.offer:
The dark elves laugh at a goblin with empty hands. I will make you proper gear, but you fetch what I need.
Stitcher Nibb has a leather strip and a shaft put by for me. Then bring a wing from the cave bats that roost in the far north-east chamber.
Will you bring me all three?
quests.declined: Then fight with your teeth. See how long they last.
quests.started: Leather and a shaft from Nibb, a wing from the bats. Quick, now.

steps.journal: Ask Stitcher Nibb for the leather strip and the wooden shaft.
steps.says: For Grukk? Here, a leather strip and a shaft, straight enough. Tell him he still owes me for the last ones.

steps.journal: Take a cave bat wing from the cave bats in the far north-east chamber of the cavern.
Bring the leather strip, the wooden shaft and the cave bat wing to Pitmaster Grukk.
steps.says: All three. Give it here... wing for the grip, leather to bind. There. It is yours. Try not to cut yourself.

quests.offer:
One more thing before Neriak gets you. A great spider nests in the old camp outside the mouth, far to the south. We call her Mother Mossweb. She took two lookouts last moon.
She bites first and she bites deep, so do not stand and stare. Bring me her fang, and I will teach you the last thing I have for a new one.
Will you kill Mother Mossweb?
quests.declined: She will only get fatter while you wait.
quests.started: South, down the long tunnel and out past the mouth, among the old huts. Keep moving when she comes.

steps.journal: Take Mossweb's fang from the spider Mother Mossweb, in the old camp outside the mouth, far to the south.
Bring Mossweb's fang to Pitmaster Grukk.
steps.says:
Her fang! Hah! The lookouts will sleep tonight. You are no new one any more.
Learn this, and see Gatekeeper Skabber when you are ready for Neriak.

quests.name: The Road to Neriak
quests.offer:
The dark elves of Neriak pay well for goblins who are quick and quiet, and Grukk says you are both.
You have earned the road, little one. I will set you down among your own guild in Neriak, and your spirit will rest there.
Shall I send you to Neriak?
quests.declined: Neriak will wait. Dark elves are good at waiting.
quests.started: Keep your blade close and your purse closer!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Skabber when you are ready to go to Neriak.

quests.name: Furs for Neriak
quests.offer:
Back again, and bigger! Hah. Listen. The dark elves of Neriak pay good coin for white fur, and the Eyrie's snow is full of drift rats wearing it.
Ride Rukkit's coach to the Goldfeather Eyrie. The rats run on the snow east of the hunters' outpost. Three clumps of fur, clean, no holes.
Will you skin some rats for Grukk?
quests.declined: No fur, no coin. Come back when you want both.
quests.started: Three clumps. And keep your own ears warm. Cold ears snap off.

steps.journal: Take three clumps of drift rat fur from the drift rats east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring three clumps of drift rat fur to Pitmaster Grukk in Moss Mouth.
steps.says: White as a dark elf's lie! Hah. These fetch a fine price. Here, your share is a lesson. Watch, and learn this.

quests.name: Grukk's Bargain
quests.offer:
Your blade is a toy now, little one. Grukk made a deal with the Eyrie's quartermaster: he gives you ore and a shaft, and we say nice things about him.
Get them from Quartermaster Dunmore at the outpost. Then bring me silk from the rime spiders north-east of it, three skeins, to bind it all.
Will you fetch Grukk's bargain?
quests.declined: Then keep your toy, and hope nothing bites.
quests.started: Dunmore first. Do not let him talk you into paying.

steps.journal: Ask Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost for the ore and the shaft Grukk bargained for.
steps.says: A goblin from Grukk. Of course. Here is his ore, and his shaft. Tell him we are square, and count your fingers on the way out.

steps.journal: Take three skeins of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the iron ore, the wooden shaft and the rime spider silk to Pitmaster Grukk.
steps.says: Ore, shaft, silk, and nobody paid a copper. Hah! A moment... there. A real weapon. It is yours. Do not sell it.

quests.name: The Old Cat's Coat
quests.offer:
Here is a thing. A snow leopard the Eyrie folk call Old Frostjaw hunts the slopes north-east of their outpost. His pelt would buy half of Neriak.
He is old and he is mean and he bites first. Take friends from the other homes and promise them nothing. Bring Grukk the pelt.
Will you bring me Old Frostjaw's pelt?
quests.declined: Then some other goblin gets rich. Not you.
quests.started: Go with friends. Let them stand in front.

steps.journal: Take Old Frostjaw's pelt, on the slopes north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring Old Frostjaw's pelt to Pitmaster Grukk.
steps.says: Look at it! Scars and all. The dark elves will fight over it. You did well, little one. Learn this.

quests.name: Ice That Never Melts
quests.offer:
The Eyrie folk whisper about a cold thing in the ice caves north-east of their outpost. They call it the Rimeheart. It is made of ice that never melts.
Ice that never melts! Do you know what a wizard in Neriak pays for that? Break it and bring me a shard. Only one. Grukk is not greedy.
Will you break the Rimeheart for Grukk?
quests.declined: Then the wizards keep their coin. Shame.
quests.started: Take friends. Big ones. Do not tell them what the shard is worth.

steps.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Pitmaster Grukk.
steps.says: Cold! Cold, and it does not drip. Hah! Grukk will be rich. And you will be clever, because now I teach you this.

quests.name: The Bounty
quests.offer:
Grukk says you came home with ice that does not melt and a pelt worth a house. Hmm. You are no little one now. Time the other homes knew Moss Mouth's name.
The Eyrie's warden keeps a bounty book on the raiders of his river. Go to Warden Halvek at the outpost, get our name in it, and come home to me.
Will you take the warden's bounty?
quests.declined: The bounty will keep. The raiders will not.
quests.started: Rukkit's coach will take you. Come home with our name in that book.

steps.journal: Find Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: Snikkit's goblin, come for the bounty? Fine. The Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of here carry war-talons. Bring three to Dunmore: he keeps the bounty book.

steps.journal: Take three war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the three war-talons to Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: Three talons, and Halvek's word on them. Moss Mouth goes in the bounty book, first page. Go home, goblin. You earned it.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Snikkit in Moss Mouth.
steps.says: First page of the warden's book! Hah! The other homes will say Moss Mouth's name now, and say it carefully. You did that, not Grukk.

quests.name: Bound to the Mire

quests.name: A Sprout's Acorn Sash
quests.offer:
Well, well! A new sprout, and not a crumb on you yet. We shall mend that. But first things first: no brownie of the glade goes about without an acorn sash.
Weaver Mossbutton stitches them, up at the north side of the stockade. Tell her I sent you, or she will talk your ears off first.
Will you fetch your sash and show it to me?
quests.declined: No hurry, sprout. The acorns are not going anywhere.
quests.started: Off you trot. North side, by the big leaves. Follow the humming.

steps.journal: Ask Weaver Mossbutton, at the north side of the stockade, for an acorn-cap sash.
steps.says: A new sprout! Arms up. Plaited grass, seven acorn caps, one for luck. There. Not a button to pay, dear. Mind you keep it tidy.

steps.journal: Show the acorn-cap sash to Elder Thimbleroot.
steps.says: Now you look a proper brownie. Keep a crumb tucked in it. You never know when you will want one.

quests.name: Bound to the Glade
quests.offer:
The wide world is full of large feet, sprout. Have Spiritmaster Fennick bind your spirit to the glade, so that you wake here if one of them lands on you.
Then give your name to Coachman Twigg for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
quests.declined: Then look up often, sprout. Very often.
quests.started: Fennick is by the west fence. Twigg waits on the grass outside the east gate.

steps.journal: Have Spiritmaster Fennick, by the west fence of the stockade, bind your spirit to the glade.
steps.says: There now. Whatever lands on you, you will wake here among friends, and likely in time for supper. Off to Coachman Twigg with you.

steps.journal: Give your name to Coachman Twigg, outside the east gate, for his ledger.
steps.says: Name in the book, sprout! My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Thimbleroot.
steps.says:
Splendid. Now you can always come home, one way or the other.
Twigg's coach will carry you to Freeport if its ledger knows you, but the road to Rivervale is earned. Hedgewarden Tansy, just north of me, has work for you.

quests.name: Mayflies in the Honey
quests.offer:
So you are the new sprout. Good, I need quick hands. The mayflies are swarming in the hollow south of the stockade, and they are into the honey pots again.
Swat a few swarms and bring me three wings. Then I will show you a trick worth having.
Will you thin them out?
quests.declined: Then it is dry bread for supper, and you may tell Pippkin why.
quests.started: Three wings. Out the east gate and round to the south, down in the hollow.

steps.journal: Take three mayfly wings from the mayfly swarms in the hollow south of the stockade.
Bring three mayfly wings to Hedgewarden Tansy.
steps.says: Three wings, and no honey on your fingers. I am almost surprised. Now watch closely, sprout, and learn this.

quests.name: A Sprout's Arms
quests.offer:
A brownie's wits are sharp, but a wolf does not mind wits. I will make you proper gear, if you fetch what I need.
Weaver Mossbutton has a leather strip and a shaft put by for me. Then take a fang from the glade snakes in the woods west of the stockade.
Will you bring me all three?
quests.declined: Then stay inside the fence, where your wits are enough.
quests.started: Leather and a shaft from Mossbutton, a fang from the snakes. Hop to it.

steps.journal: Ask Weaver Mossbutton for the leather strip and the wooden shaft.
steps.says: For Tansy? Here you are, dear: a strip of leather and a nice straight shaft. Tell her she still has my good needle.

steps.journal: Take a glade snake fang from the glade snakes in the woods west of the stockade.
Bring the leather strip, the wooden shaft and the glade snake fang to Hedgewarden Tansy.
steps.says: All three! A moment... the fang for a point, the leather for a grip. There. It is yours, sprout. Do not poke the grocer with it.

quests.name: Old Greyback
quests.offer:
One thing more before Rivervale has you. An old badger we call Greyback has dug in among the trees far to the north-west. He has dug up two of our gardens and chased the gardeners up a pine.
He is bigger than three of us and cross as a wet cat, so strike first. Bring me his claw, and I will teach you the last trick I have for a sprout.
Will you see to Old Greyback?
quests.declined: He will not grow any sweeter while you wait.
quests.started: North-west, a good long walk through the trees. Mind his claws.

steps.journal: Take Greyback's claw from the badger Old Greyback in the woods far north-west of the stockade.
Bring Greyback's claw to Hedgewarden Tansy.
steps.says:
Greyback's own claw! The gardeners can come down from their pine. You are a sprout no longer.
Learn this, and see Gatekeeper Burrowby at the east gate when you are ready for Rivervale.

quests.name: The Road to Rivervale
quests.offer:
The halflings of Rivervale keep good tables and open doors, and they have always been kind to our kind. Tansy says you are ready for them.
You have earned the road, sprout. I will set you down among your own guild in Rivervale, and your spirit will rest there.
Shall I send you to Rivervale?
quests.declined: Rivervale will keep. Halflings are patient about guests.
quests.started: Mind your manners, and save me a pie!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Burrowby when you are ready to go to Rivervale.

quests.notes: Ours: the gatekeeper's port to Rivervale, the brownie's wire race's city, each class to its own guild's spot there (teleport to mainland: the wire race's start row for the class), bound there: the passage the five starter quests earn (a coach runs between the home and Freeport for anyone). Repeatable, so one back in the homeland is sent again; no reward, so none is had twice. Written by tools/quests/gen_homelands.py from tools/quests/homelands/brownie.json.

quests.name: A Quilt for the Winter
quests.offer:
Winter is coming, sprout, and Thimbleroot's old bones feel it. I mean to stitch him a quilt, and only snowfield badger pelts are warm enough.
Ride Twigg's coach to the Goldfeather Eyrie. The badgers dig on the snow east of the hunters' outpost there. Bring me two pelts, nice and thick.
Will you fetch two badger pelts?
quests.declined: Then the elder shivers a little longer.
quests.started: Two pelts. Badgers are Greyback's cousins, and just as cross.

steps.journal: Take two snowfield badger pelts from the badgers on the snow east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring two snowfield badger pelts to Hedgewarden Tansy in the glade.
steps.says: Oh, they are lovely and warm! The elder will purr like a cat. Now, sprout, a trick for your trouble. Learn this.

quests.name: A Sprout No More
quests.offer:
You have outgrown your little arms, sprout. Time for proper ones. Mossbutton has a leather strip for me, and the Eyrie's quartermaster has iron.
Then bring me two skeins of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost. Nothing binds a grip like it.
Will you gather it all?
quests.declined: Then mind you do not break the old ones.
quests.started: Mossbutton first, she is on the way. Then Dunmore, then the spiders.

steps.journal: Ask Weaver Mossbutton at the stockade for Tansy's leather strip.
steps.says: Tansy's strip? Here it is, sprout, and here is a crumb for the road. Do not tell Tansy. She says I spoil you.

steps.journal: Ask Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost for iron ore.
steps.says: A brownie? Tansy's? Well, I owe the glade for that honey cake. Here is your ore. Carry it with both hands.

steps.journal: Take two skeins of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the leather strip, the iron ore and the rime spider silk to Hedgewarden Tansy.
steps.says: All of it! Iron for the edge, leather and silk for the grip... there. It is yours, and it is no toy. Do not poke the grocer.

quests.name: Mittens for the Little Ones
quests.offer:
The little sprouts of the glade have cold paws this year, and I have promised them mittens. The softest fur there is grows on the frostpaw cubs.
They play on the snow north of the Eyrie outpost. Bring me three tufts of their fur. Hunt with the other homes: those cubs bite.
Will you fetch three tufts?
quests.declined: Then the little ones blow on their paws a while longer.
quests.started: Three tufts. Mind the cubs. They are bigger than they look.

steps.journal: Take three frostpaw tufts from the frostpaw cubs north of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring three frostpaw tufts to Hedgewarden Tansy.
steps.says: So soft! The little ones will have the warmest paws in the Homelands. You deserve a good trick for this. Learn it.

quests.name: Cold for the Larder
quests.offer:
The Eyrie's quartermaster tells me there is a thing of ice in the caves north-east of his outpost. The Rimeheart, they call it. Ice that never melts!
Dunmore's stores spoil like ours do. Break the Rimeheart and take him a shard, and his larder stays cold all summer. Then come home to me.
Will you face the Rimeheart?
quests.declined: Then the butter melts, and the caves stay cold.
quests.started: Take friends, sprout, and come home in one piece.

steps.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: Ice that never melts, for my larder? Tansy said a brownie would think of it. Tell her the honey cakes are on me this winter.

steps.journal: Return to Hedgewarden Tansy in the glade.
steps.says: Dunmore's larder is cold and the Rimeheart is broken. You are a hedgewarden in all but name, sprout. Learn this.

quests.name: A Good Neighbor
quests.offer:
Tansy tells me you have kept the whole Eyrie in honey cakes and cold butter. Splendid! A brownie is a good neighbor, sprout, and so are you.
The Eyrie's folk could use a good neighbor now. Ask Quartermaster Dunmore what they need, and help them. Then come home and tell me all.
Will you go and be a good neighbor?
quests.declined: Neighbors keep. Come when you are ready.
quests.started: Twigg's coach will take you. Mind your manners!

steps.journal: Ask Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost what the outpost needs.
steps.says: What do we need? Quiet nights. The raiders keep the warden up. Go and ask Warden Halvek, he will tell you more than I.

steps.journal: Find Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: Dunmore sent you? The Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of here steal from our camp. Two of their war-talons would warn them off.

steps.journal: Take two war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the two war-talons to Warden Halvek.
steps.says: Two talons. They will think twice about our camp now. The glade raises good neighbors. Go home and tell your elder so.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Thimbleroot in the glade.
steps.says: Halvek's thanks came by the coach, and a honey cake with it. You went out a sprout and came home a neighbor to every home. Use it well, dear.

choices.says: A fine choice, dear. It is yours.
A fine choice, dear. It is yours.

quests.offer:
Tansy tells me you have kept the whole Eyrie in honey cakes and cold butter. Splendid! A brownie is a good neighbor, sprout, and so are you.
The Eyrie's folk could use a good neighbor now. Ask Quartermaster Dunmore what they need, and help them. Then come home and tell me all.
Will you go and be a good neighbor?

quests.name: A Spark's Dewdrop Ring
quests.offer:
Oh! A new little spark, and your wings hardly dry. Welcome, welcome. Now, every pixie of the thicket wears a dewdrop ring, so the mist knows us and lets us through.
Spinner Gossamer catches the dew for them at first light. She is a few wingbeats south-east of here.
Will you fetch your ring and show it to me?
quests.declined: As you like, little spark. The dew comes every morning.
quests.started: Off you flit! South-east, just past the pines.

steps.journal: Ask Spinner Gossamer, a few steps south-east of Elder Brightwing, for a dewdrop ring.
steps.says: A new spark! Hold out a finger. One twist of silk, one drop of first dew. There! It will never dry. No charge, the dew is free.

steps.journal: Show the dewdrop ring to Elder Brightwing.
steps.says: How it shines! Now the mist will part for you, little spark, as it does for all of us.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests): the pixie's level 1, at Misty Thicket, on the cities' level 1 quest: a piece of equipment fetched from a merchant and shown to the giver. quests.name: Bound to the Thicket
quests.offer:
The world beyond the mist is full of nets and jars, little spark. Have Spiritmaster Glimmerdew bind your spirit to the thicket, so that you wake here if you fall.
Then give your name to Coachman Fernwick for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
quests.declined: Then fly high, and keep away from jars.
quests.started: Glimmerdew is off to the west, among the far pines. Fernwick waits to the south-east, past Gossamer.

steps.journal: Have Spiritmaster Glimmerdew, among the pines to the west, bind your spirit to the thicket.
steps.says: Done, and gently. Should you fall, the mist will carry you back to me. Now flit along to Coachman Fernwick.

steps.journal: Give your name to Coachman Fernwick, south-east of the elder, for his ledger.
steps.says: In the ledger you go, small as you are! My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Brightwing.
steps.says:
Lovely. Now the thicket can always find you, and you it.
Fernwick's coach will carry you to Freeport if its ledger knows you, but the way to the elves is earned. Huntress Thistledown, just north of me, has work for you.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests): the pixie's level 2, at Misty Thicket, on the cities' level 2 quest: the spiritmaster's bind and the coachman's ledger. quests.name: Rats in the Brambles
quests.offer:
The new spark! Good. The bramble rats are gnawing the berry canes to the south-west again, and a rat is a great beast to a pixie. Time you learned that it bleeds.
Bring me three of their tails, and I will teach you something worth the scratches.
Will you hunt them?
quests.declined: Then no berries this year, and you may tell the elder why.
quests.started: Three tails. South-west, where the brambles grow thick. Go for the eyes.

steps.journal: Take three bramble rat tails from the bramble rats in the brambles south-west of the pines.
Bring three bramble rat tails to Huntress Thistledown.
steps.says: Three tails, each one longer than you are! Well flown. Now watch my hands, little spark, and learn this.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests): the pixie's level 3, at Misty Thicket, on the cities' level 3 quest: a hunt for drops; each class is taught what its own city's level 3 quest teaches it. quests.name: A Spark's Arms
quests.offer:
The elves will not send you out with only your sparkle. I will make you proper gear, if you bring me what I need.
Spinner Gossamer has a leather strip and a shaft put by for me. Then take a shell from the thicket beetles on the low ground to the east.
Will you bring me all three?
quests.declined: Then sparkle hard, and hope it is enough.
quests.started: Leather and a shaft from Gossamer, a shell from the beetles. Quick as you can!

steps.journal: Ask Spinner Gossamer for the leather strip and the wooden shaft.
steps.says: For Thistledown? Here: a strip of leather and a shaft, both far too big for either of us. Tell her to mind the canes.

steps.journal: Take a thicket beetle shell from the thicket beetles on the low ground east of the pines.
Bring the leather strip, the wooden shaft and the thicket beetle shell to Huntress Thistledown.
steps.says: All three! A pinch of dust, a twist... there. It will grow to fit your hand. It is yours, little spark.

quests.name: Redsting
quests.offer:
One hunt more before the elves have you. A great red hornet we call Redsting hunts the woods far to the south. She has carried off two of our scouts, wings and all.
She is faster than you and she knows it, so strike first and do not stop. Bring me her stinger, and I will teach you the last thing I have for a spark.
Will you hunt Redsting?
quests.declined: She will not grow slower while you wait.
quests.started: South, a long flight through the trees. Listen for the buzzing.

steps.journal: Take Redsting's stinger from the hornet Redsting in the woods far south of the pines.
Bring Redsting's stinger to Huntress Thistledown.
steps.says:
Redsting's own stinger! The scouts will fly south again. You are a little spark no longer. Well, a little one still.
Learn this, and see Gatekeeper Thistlewhirl to the east when you are ready for the elves.

quests.name: The Elves' Wood
quests.offer:
The elves of Tethelin and the Fayspires have always welcomed our kind, and they will teach you as their own. Thistledown says you are ready.
You have earned the flight, little spark. I will set you down among your own guild in the elves' wood, and your spirit will rest there.
Shall I send you to the elves?
quests.declined: The elves are patient. They live a long time.
quests.started: Fly well, little spark!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Thistlewhirl when you are ready to go to the elves.
