quests.name: Whiskers and Fur
quests.offer:
Little spark, you have grown! Well, a little. The homes keep a hunters' outpost on the snow under the Goldfeather Eyrie, and pixies hunt there too.
Ride Fernwick's coach there. Drift rat whiskers make the best wand cores, and a badger pelt makes a fine warm nest. Find both east of the outpost.
Will you hunt the Eyrie's snow?
quests.declined: The snow will wait. It is good at that.
quests.started: Two whiskers and a pelt. Keep your wings dry, they freeze!

steps.journal: Take two drift rat whiskers from the drift rats east of the Eyrie outpost.
Take a snowfield badger pelt from the badgers on the snow east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the drift rat whiskers and the badger pelt to Huntress Thistledown.
steps.says: Whiskers for wands, and a nest for winter! You hunt like a pixie twice your size. Now watch my hands, and learn this.

quests.name: Silk for a Spark
quests.offer:
Your arms are too small for you now, little spark. I will make you new ones, light as a wing and sharp as a sting.
Spinner Gossamer has a shaft for me. Then bring me two skeins of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost. Frost silk holds a spell.
Will you bring me the shaft and the silk?
quests.declined: Then your old arms will have to do.
quests.started: Gossamer first, then the spiders. Do not get stuck in their webs!

steps.journal: Ask Spinner Gossamer for the shaft Huntress Thistledown put by.
steps.says: Thistledown's shaft, yes, yes. Here! I polished it with morning dew. It is very shiny now.

steps.journal: Take two skeins of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

quests.name: The Grey Cat
quests.offer:
There is a great grey cat on the slopes north-east of the Eyrie outpost. Old Frostjaw, they call him. He has eaten three of their hunters, and he looks up at us.
A cat is a terrible beast to a pixie. That is why you must hunt him: so you will never fear one again. Take friends from the other homes.
Will you hunt Old Frostjaw?
quests.declined: Then stay off the slopes, little spark.
quests.started: Stay above him if you can. And take friends!

steps.journal: Kill Old Frostjaw on the slopes north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
Return to Huntress Thistledown.
steps.says: The grey cat is gone, and here you are, wings and all! No cat will frighten you now. Learn this.

quests.name: A Shard for the Scout
quests.offer:
Scout Feyla of the Eyrie watches the river and sees everything, a little like us. She has sent word: something walks in the ice caves north-east of the outpost.
The Rimeheart, she calls it. Break it, take her a shard so she can see it is done, and come back to me.
Will you face the Rimeheart?
quests.declined: Then the scout keeps watching, and the caves grow colder.
quests.started: Do not go into those caves alone, little spark. Not even a little bit alone.

steps.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Scout Feyla on the river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: A pixie broke the Rimeheart? I watched the caves go quiet and wondered. Tell Thistledown the river thanks the thicket.

steps.journal: Return to Huntress Thistledown.
steps.says: Feyla's word came by the coach, and it was very nice word. You are the bravest spark in the thicket. Learn this.

quests.offer:
Thistledown says you hunt grey cats and ice now! My little spark. The Eyrie's scout has asked for the sharpest eyes in the Homelands, and a pixie's are.
Go to Scout Feyla on the river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost, and help her watch. When it is done, come home, and you will choose your path.

quests.declined: Then the scout watches alone a little longer.
quests.started: Fernwick's coach will take you. Fly well, and come home!

steps.journal: Find Scout Feyla on the frozen river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: Brightwing's spark! Good. The Goldfeather raiders carry war-talons. Take two, and show them to Warden Halvek so he can send them home.

steps.journal: Take two war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the two war-talons to Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: Feyla's pixie, with two talons? The raiders will know the river is watched. Fly home, little one. Your elder is waiting.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Brightwing in the thicket.
steps.says: There you are! The whole thicket has heard. You flew out a spark and came home a light. Shine well, little one.

quests.name: Bound to the Valley
quests.offer:
The winds beyond the cliffs are rough with small wings, little friend. Have Spiritmaster Lirelle bind your spirit to the valley, so that you wake here if they throw you down.
Then give your name to Coachman Tumbleseed for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.

quests.declined: Then stay under the trees, where the wind is kind.

steps.journal: Have Spiritmaster Lirelle, north-east of the elder, bind your spirit to the valley.

Larkspur says you made the Eyrie's warden laugh, and broke its coldest heart. You are no new fairy now, little friend. You are a fairy of the Homelands.
The Eyrie's warden and scout have work for you still. Go to Warden Halvek at the outpost and do as they ask. Then come home, and choose your road.
Will you go back to the Eyrie?
quests.declined: Then rest, and come when the wind is right.
quests.started: Tumbleseed's coach will take you. Fly true!

steps.journal: Find Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: Moonpetal's fairy again! The scout needs a hand, and you have two. Scout Feyla is on the river's far reach. Go to her.

steps.journal: Find Scout Feyla on the frozen river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: The fairy who made Halvek laugh! The Goldfeather raiders carry war-talons. Bring me three, and the river can rest.

steps.journal: Take three war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the three war-talons to Scout Feyla.
steps.says: Three talons! The river rests. Tell Dunmore at the outpost he can open the stores again, then go home.

steps.journal: Tell Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost the river is safe.
steps.says: Safe? Then the stores open, and tonight there will be laughing at the Eyrie. Go home, fairy. Your elder is waiting.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Moonpetal in the valley.
steps.says: Home again, and the whole Eyrie laughing behind you! That is the oldest magic, little friend. Keep it close.

choices.says: A happy choice! It is yours, little friend.
A happy choice! It is yours, little friend.

quests.name: A Pup's Pack Collar
quests.offer:
Come closer, pup. Let me smell you. Hrrn. Milk and ashes. You are ours, then. But the guards cannot smell as I can, and they bite what they do not know.
Every pup wears the pack collar. Hidescraper Yipp cuts them, a few steps south of here, by the tents.
Will you fetch your collar and show it to me?
quests.declined: Then stay by the fire, pup, where the guards can see you.
quests.started: South, by the tents. Follow the smell of wet hide.

steps.journal: Ask Hidescraper Yipp, a few steps south of Elder Grawl, for a pup's pack collar.
steps.says: Grawl's new pup? Chin up. Badger hide, the pack's brand, a good tight knot. There. A pup pays nothing. A grown gnoll pays double.

steps.journal: Show the pup's pack collar to Elder Grawl.
steps.says: Good. Now you wear the pack's mark, and the pack will know you by sight as I know you by scent.

quests.name: Bound to the Burrow
quests.offer:
A gnoll who falls far from the pack is lost to it. Have Spiritmaster Rakk bind your spirit to the burrow, so that you wake here when you fall.
Then give your name to Coachman Skulk for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
quests.declined: Then do not stray past the fence, pup.
quests.started: Rakk is a few steps east of here. Skulk waits on the road outside the south-east gate.

steps.journal: Have Spiritmaster Rakk, a few steps east of the elder, bind your spirit to the burrow.
steps.says: It is done. Fall where you will, pup: you wake here, with the pack's fire in your nose. Now go and give Coachman Skulk your name.

steps.journal: Give your name to Coachman Skulk, on the road outside the south-east gate, for his ledger.
steps.says: A pup for the ledger. My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Grawl.
steps.says:
Good. The burrow holds your spirit, and the road knows your name.
Skulk's coach will carry you to Freeport if its ledger knows you, but the road to Neriak is earned. Packleader Varg, beside me, has work for you.

quests.name: Badgers on the Hill
quests.offer:
So you are the pup. Hrr. The hill badgers are digging under our fence from the north-west, and a badger hole breaks a guard's leg as well as a spear does.
Hunt them on the hill and bring me three pelts. Then I will teach you something worth your teeth.
Will you hunt them?

quests.name: A Whelp's War Band
quests.offer:
Hm. A whelp. Stand up. Straighter. Good. You have a spine, at least. But you wear nothing of Thedruk, and the sentries crack the skulls of strangers.
Every whelp wears the war band on its arm. Hidecutter Marga makes them, south-west of the totems.
Will you fetch your war band and show it to me?
quests.declined: Then stand there and be useless. It is your skull.

steps.says: Gorruk's whelp? Arm. Boiled hide, the camp's brand, burned in deep. There. It costs nothing. Lose it and it costs you teeth.

steps.journal: Show the Thedruk war band to Elder Gorruk.
steps.says: Good. Now you wear the camp's mark. Dishonour it and I will take it back myself, arm and all.

quests.name: Bound to Thedruk
quests.offer:
An orc who dies far from camp dies for nothing. Have Spiritmaster Urzog bind your spirit to Thedruk, so that you wake here and fight again.
Then give your name to Coachman Dursh for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
quests.declined: Then die close to camp, whelp. It saves us the walk.
quests.started: Urzog is to the north-west. Dursh keeps his coach on the open ground south of here.

steps.journal: Have Spiritmaster Urzog, north-west of the elder, bind your spirit to Thedruk.
steps.says: Done. Die where you like, whelp. You wake here, and you fight again. Now go and give Coachman Dursh your name.

steps.journal: Give your name to Coachman Dursh, south of the elder, for his ledger.
steps.says: A whelp for the ledger. My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Gorruk.
steps.says:
Good. Now you cannot be lost, and you cannot stay dead. An orc needs little more.
Dursh's coach will carry you to Freeport if its ledger knows you, but the road to Halas is earned. Warleader Krugg, beside me, has work for you.

quests.offer:

Bring me three tails. Then I will teach you something a warrior needs.
Will you kill them?
quests.declined: Too proud for rats? You have earned no pride yet.
quests.started: Three tails. West, past the bare hill. Go.

steps.says: Three tails. You did not complain. Good. Now watch, whelp, and learn this.

quests.name: A Calf's Nose Ring
quests.offer:
So. A new calf stands in the mouth of our mine. You have horns, but the herd does not know you yet.
Every Rustel wears the herd's iron in its nose. Smith Dargha hammers the rings at the old forge, just east of the mine's mouth.
Will you fetch your nose ring and show it to me?
quests.declined: Then stand there, nameless. The herd can wait longer than you can.
quests.started: Go. Dargha is at the old forge, just east of the mouth.

steps.journal: Ask Smith Dargha, at the old forge east of the mine's mouth, for a calf's nose ring.
steps.says: Hornbrand sent you? Hold still. Hah, it does not hurt, calf. Gerntar iron, dug by the herd. No charge for one of ours.

steps.journal: Show the calf's nose ring to Elder Hornbrand.
steps.says: Good iron. Now any Rustel who sees you knows whose calf you are. Do not shame the ring.

quests.name: Bound to the Mine
quests.offer:
A calf charges first and thinks after. So first let Spiritmaster Ruhga bind your spirit to the mine, in the tunnel behind me, to the west.
Then give your name to Coachman Durruk, on the grass east of the old forge. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
quests.declined: Then charge nothing bigger than a rat until you do.
quests.started: Ruhga is in the tunnel to the west. Durruk waits on the grass east of the old forge.

steps.journal: Have Spiritmaster Ruhga, in the tunnel west of the elder, bind your spirit to the mine.
steps.says: It is done. Fall where you will, calf, and you will wake here under the stone. Now go and give Coachman Durruk your name.

steps.journal: Give your name to Coachman Durruk, on the grass east of the old forge, for his ledger.
steps.says: A new calf! My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Hornbrand.
steps.says:
Good. Now the stone will always call you back.
Durruk's coach will carry you where its ledgers know you, but the road to Grobb is earned. Warden Ironhide, outside the mouth, has work for you.

quests.name: Rats in the Grain
quests.offer:
You are the new calf. Good, I need hooves. Mine rats are in the herd's grain again, and they breed in the grass east of here.
Stamp them out and bring me three of their tails. Then I will teach you something a Rustel should know.
Will you hunt them?
quests.declined: Then you eat what the rats leave.
quests.started: Three tails. East, past the old forge and the coach.

steps.journal: Take three mine rat tails from the mine rats on the grass east of the mine.
Bring three mine rat tails to Warden Ironhide.
steps.says: Three tails, and no bites worth showing. You will do. Now plant your hooves, watch me, and learn this.

quests.name: A Waking Band
quests.offer:
So. Another of us opens eyes it no longer has. Be still a moment. The first waking is the strangest.
Each of the woken wears a band of the kings' bronze, so the sentinels do not take you for a robber. Shroudmaker Corwen keeps them, up the hall to the north.
Will you fetch your waking band and show it to me?
quests.declined: As you like. We have nothing here if not time.
quests.started: Corwen's alcove is up the hall to the north, on the east side.

steps.journal: Ask Shroudmaker Corwen, up the hall north of Elder Ossric, for a waking band.
steps.says: Newly woken? Give me your wrist. What is left of it. There: the kings' bronze, and it will not slip. No charge. The dead do not bill the dead.

steps.journal: Show the waking band to Elder Ossric.
steps.says: It fits, as far as anything fits us now. Wear it, and the tomb will know you for its own.

quests.name: Bound to the Tomb
quests.offer:
You have died once. It need not become a habit. Have Spiritmaster Vellum bind you to the tomb, so that you gather yourself here if your bones are scattered.
Then give your name to Coachman Grimsby, up the hall. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
quests.declined: Then do try not to fall apart in the meantime.
quests.started: Vellum keeps the alcove to the south-west. Grimsby waits up the hall to the north.

steps.journal: Have Spiritmaster Vellum, in the alcove south-west of the elder, bind your spirit to the tomb.
steps.says: It is done. Wherever your bones fall, they will find their way back here. Now go and give Coachman Grimsby your name.

steps.journal: Give your name to Coachman Grimsby, up the hall north of the elder, for his ledger.
steps.says: Another one up and about! My coach was a hearse once. It runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for those whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Ossric.
steps.says:
Good. Now even the worst day ends with you back among us.
Grimsby's coach goes where its ledgers know you, but the road to Freeport's guilds is earned. Captain Harrow, beside me, has work for you.

quests.name: Beetles in the Bones
quests.offer:
You are the new one. Good. Tomb beetles have come up out of the excavators' pit, down the hall to the south, and they gnaw at those of us who have not woken yet.
Crack them and bring me three of their shells. Then I will show you something every one of the watch should know.
Will you hunt them?
quests.declined: Then the sleepers are gnawed a little longer. They will not complain.
quests.started: Three shells. The pit is down the hall to the south.

steps.journal: Take three tomb beetle shells from the tomb beetles in the pit south of the great hall.
Bring three tomb beetle shells to Captain Harrow.
steps.says: Three shells, and you are still in one piece. More or less. Now attend, and learn this.

quests.name: Arms for the Woken
quests.offer:
Bare bone breaks. I will make you proper gear from the kings' stores, but you will fetch what I need.
Shroudmaker Corwen has cord and a shaft set by for me. Then take a wing from the crypt bats that roost in the south passage, past the pit.

quests.declined: Then go as you are, and count your ribs afterwards.
quests.started: Cord and a shaft from Corwen, a wing from the bats. Go.

steps.journal: Take a crypt bat wing from the crypt bats in the passage south of the pit.

steps.says: All three. A moment... there. It is yours. It has outlasted better hands than ours.

quests.declined: She will not grow more honest while you wait.

The living fear us, but Freeport is not so particular, and its guilds will train you as they would any other.
You have earned the road, woken one. I will set you down among your own guild in Freeport, and your spirit will rest there.

quests.started: Walk tall, and keep your bones together!

Ride Grimsby's coach to the Eyrie. Corwen wants drift rat fur to line the shrouds, and I want two badger claws. Both are on the snow east of the outpost.
Will you hunt the Eyrie's snow?

quests.started: Grimsby's coach will take you. The cold will not trouble you. Small mercies.

He asked for the watch by name. It is not every day the living ask the dead for help. Kill five of the cubs.

quests.offer:
Spiritmaster Oswin of the Eyrie outpost writes that a thing walks the ice caves north-east of it, the Rimeheart: cold, old and not alive. Rather like us, but less polite.
Break it, and carry a shard to Oswin, so that he can be sure it does not wake again. Then come back to me.

quests.started: Go with friends. Even bones can be broken.

steps.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

steps.says: The Rimeheart's own ice. Nothing stirs in it now. Tell your captain the outpost thanks the tomb. I never thought I would say that.

steps.journal: Return to Captain Harrow.
steps.says: Oswin's thanks, to the tomb. The kings would be amused. You have done the watch proud. Learn this.

quests.name: A Watch Among the Living
quests.offer:
Harrow says you have earned your place on the watch. Before the woken choose their path, each stands one watch among the living at the Eyrie, so they learn we mean no harm.
Spiritmaster Oswin at the Eyrie outpost knows you now. Go to him, do as the outpost asks, then come back to me and choose your path.
Will you stand watch among the living?
quests.declined: We are patient. It is the one thing death teaches.
quests.started: Go. Try not to frighten anyone.

steps.journal: Find Spiritmaster Oswin at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: The woken one who broke the Rimeheart. The outpost has heard. Scout Feyla, on the river's far reach, needs a steady hand: go to her.

steps.journal: Find Scout Feyla on the frozen river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: Oswin sent you? I see. Well, the raiders will run from you if from nothing else. Bring me three of their war-talons.

steps.journal: Take three war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.

quests.name: A Sprout's Root Sash
quests.offer:
Ahh. A new cap pushes up through the dark. Welcome, little sprout. Stand a while. There is no hurry here.
Every sprout of the hall wears a sash of braided root, to hold it to the ground it grew from. Capwright Chanter braids them, a little way up the passage to the north.
Will you fetch your root sash and show it to me?
quests.declined: Then rest, sprout. The hall will still be damp tomorrow.
quests.started: Slowly, now. Chanter is a little way up the passage to the north.

steps.journal: Ask Capwright Chanter, up the passage north of Elder Moldcap, for a sprout's root sash.
steps.says: The elder sent you? Hold still, sprout. Round the stem, twice... there. Root for holding, damp for growing. Nothing owed. You are one of ours.

steps.journal: Show the sprout's root sash to Elder Moldcap.
steps.says: It sits well. Wear it, and wherever you wander, a little of the hall goes with you.

quests.name: Rooted in the Hall
quests.offer:
A sprout is soft, and the caverns are not. Let Spiritmaster Sporewell root your spirit in the hall, so that you grow again here if you are trodden down.
Then give your name to Coachman Inkcap for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
quests.declined: No hurry. But tread softly until you do.
quests.started: Sporewell is down the passage to the east. Inkcap keeps his coach to the north-east.

steps.journal: Have Spiritmaster Sporewell, down the passage east of the elder, bind your spirit to the hall.
steps.says: It is done. Should you be trodden down, you will sprout again here in the damp. Now go and give Coachman Inkcap your name.

steps.journal: Give your name to Coachman Inkcap, in the passage north-east of the elder, for his ledger.
steps.says: A new sprout! My coach is slow, but it gets there. It runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for those whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Moldcap.
steps.says:
Good. Now you are rooted, and may wander without fear.
Inkcap's coach goes where its ledgers know you, but the way up to the elves is earned. Warden Morel, beside me, has work for you.

Ride Inkcap's coach to the Eyrie. Bring me three clumps of drift rat fur and a badger's pelt from the snow east of the outpost. Fur keeps the spore-beds warm.

quests.name: The Cold That Kills
quests.offer:
Something walks the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost, the Rimeheart. Where it walks the ground freezes deep, and nothing grows. Nothing at all.
A cap cannot let that be. Break it, and bring me a shard, so the elders can see what kind of cold it was.

steps.says: Ice that never melts... the spores shrink from it. It is good that it is broken. You have done the hall proud. Learn this.

quests.name: A Shape for Qeynos
quests.offer:
In Qeynos the humans will take you for one of their own, so long as your armour holds its shape around you. They train any who come in good faith.
You have earned the way, bright one. I will set you down among your own guild there, and your light will rest in Qeynos.
Shall I send you to Qeynos?
quests.declined: The swamp will hold your light a while longer.
quests.started: Burn bright, and keep your helm on!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Dimlight when you are ready to go to Qeynos.

quests.name: White Fur for the Lamps
quests.offer:
You burn steadier now. Good. The Homelands keep an outpost on the frozen river under the Goldfeather Eyrie, and every home sends its young there.
The drift rats on the snow east of it wear a white fur that holds a glow. Glimmer packs her lamps with it. Ride Wick's coach there, and bring me three clumps.
Will you go out into the cold for us?
quests.declined: The cold is patient. So are we.
quests.started: Burn close to the others there. The snow eats small lights.

steps.journal: Take three clumps of drift rat fur from the drift rats on the snow east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the three clumps of drift rat fur to Watchlight Gleam.
steps.says: Three clumps, and still warm. Glimmer's lamps will glow through the long nights. Be still now, and learn this.

quests.name: An Eye for the Dark
quests.offer:
The pale owls of the Eyrie see by night, and they hunt our wandering lights. Their eyes are what lets them.
Lampwright Glimmer has oil set aside for me. Then bring me two eyes of the pale owls north of the Eyrie outpost, and I will shape you something better to hold.
Will you bring me the oil and the eyes?
quests.declined: Then hold what you have, and hold it tight.
quests.started: Oil from Glimmer, eyes from the owls. Do not let them see you first.

steps.journal: Ask Lampwright Glimmer for the lantern oil Gleam set aside.
steps.says: Gleam's oil. Here. It burns clean and slow, as a light should. Do not spill it on yourself.

steps.journal: Take two pale owl eyes from the pale owls north of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the lantern oil and the two pale owl eyes to Watchlight Gleam.
steps.says: Oil to burn, eyes to see. A moment, while I bind them... there. It is yours. It will not fail you in the dark.

quests.name: Cubs That Chase Lights
quests.offer:
Word came on Wick's coach. The frostpaw cubs north of the Eyrie outpost have learned to chase lights, the way Duskpaw did. Two of ours have gone dark in the snow.
They are only cubs. They will not stay cubs. Put out six of them before they learn more.
Will you hunt the frostpaw cubs?
quests.declined: Then they grow, and they learn.
quests.started: Six. Then come back, and burn bright.

steps.journal: Kill six frostpaw cubs on the snow north of the Eyrie outpost.
Return to Watchlight Gleam.
steps.says: Six. The snow is safer for small lights now. You are not small. Learn this.

quests.name: The Cold That Puts Out Lights
quests.offer:
There is a cold in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost that puts out any light that drifts too near. The hunters call it the Rimeheart.
Break it. Take a shard to Spiritmaster Oswin at the outpost: he keeps the spirits of every home, and he will know what to do with it. Then come back.
Will you face the Rimeheart?
quests.declined: Then keep away from the caves. Far away.
quests.started: Do not go alone. A light alone in that cold goes out.

steps.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Spiritmaster Oswin at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: So cold, even now. I will keep it far from the bound spirits. Tell Gleam the lights of the Feerrott may drift here safely.

steps.journal: Return to Watchlight Gleam.
steps.says: You came back, and you burn as bright as ever. Brighter. Learn this.

quests.name: The Long Light
quests.offer:
Gleam says you burn steady now, little flame. Not so little. Each of us, once, carries our light where the dark is thickest, so the other homes see it.
Go to Scout Feyla, who watches the Goldfeather eyrie from the frozen river. Do what she asks. Then come home, and choose your path.
Will you carry the long light?
quests.declined: Burn a while longer, then.
quests.started: Go. We will keep a place for you.

steps.journal: Find Scout Feyla on the frozen river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: A wisp? I saw you coming a long way off. Good: so will the raiders. Draw them out, and bring me two of their war-talons.

steps.journal: Take two war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the two war-talons to Scout Feyla.
steps.says: Two talons. They will think twice about lights on the river now. Tell Warden Halvek it was done.

steps.journal: Tell Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost that the raiders were drawn out.
steps.says: Feyla's word, and yours. The outpost will remember the light from the Feerrott. Go home now.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Faintglow in the West Feerrott.
steps.says: You went out into the dark and came back brighter. That is all a light can do. The swamp has one more thing for you.

Gleam says you burn steady now, little flame. Not so little. Each of us, once, carries our light where the dark is thickest, so the other homes see it.
Go to Scout Feyla, who watches the Goldfeather eyrie from the frozen river. Do what she asks. Then come home, and choose your path.
Will you carry the long light?
quests.declined: Burn a while longer, then.
quests.started: Go. We will keep a place for you.

steps.journal: Find Scout Feyla on the frozen river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: A wisp? I saw you coming a long way off. Good: so will the raiders. Draw them out, and bring me two of their war-talons.

steps.journal: Take two war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the two war-talons to Scout Feyla.
steps.says: Two talons. They will think twice about lights on the river now. Tell Warden Halvek it was done.

steps.journal: Tell Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost that the raiders were drawn out.
steps.says: Feyla's word, and yours. The outpost will remember the light from the Feerrott. Go home now.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Faintglow in the West Feerrott.
steps.says: You went out into the dark and came back brighter. That is all a light can do. The swamp has one more thing for you.

quests.name: A Shell for the Shore
quests.offer:
Welcome to the village, little fin. Up above is the land, loud and dry, but you will learn it, as we all did.
Every young one of the village wears a tide shell, so the sea knows its own. Shellwright Pearla carves them, a few steps south of here.
Will you fetch your shell and show it to me?
quests.declined: The tide will bring you back to me.
quests.started: Pearla is a few strokes to the south.

steps.journal: Ask Shellwright Pearla, a few strokes south of Elder Coralyn, for a tide shell.
steps.says: A new fin on the strand! Hold still. There: listen to it and you will hear the sea, wherever you are.

steps.journal: Show the tide shell earring to Elder Coralyn.
steps.says: It suits you. Now the sea will know you, even on the land.

quests.name: Anchored at the Strand
quests.offer:
The land unmakes careless swimmers. Have Spiritmaster Nerissa anchor your spirit to the strand, so the tide brings you home.
Then give your name to Coachman Dorran for his ledger. He keeps his coach up on the island's shore, east of the village, and it runs to Freeport and to the other homes.
Will you see them both and return to me?
quests.declined: Then swim no farther than you can swim back.
quests.started: Nerissa waits to the south-west. Dorran is up on the island's shore to the east.

steps.journal: Have Spiritmaster Nerissa, south-west of the elder, bind your spirit to the strand.
steps.says: It is done. Whatever drowns you on the land, the tide will bring you back here. Now give Coachman Dorran your name.

steps.journal: Give your name to Coachman Dorran, up on the island's shore east of the village, for his ledger.
steps.says: A fin up on the dry shore? Stranger things have ridden my coach. It runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for those whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Coralyn.
steps.says:
Good. Now you have a place in the village to come home to.
Tidewarden Merrow, a few steps north-west, has work for you. Listen to him: he is grumpy, but he is right.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests): the mermaid's level 2, at Erud's Crossing, on the cities' level 2 quest: the spiritmaster's bind and the coachman's ledger. quests.name: Crabs on the Strand
quests.offer:
The new fin. Good. The shore crabs have grown bold on the sea floor west of the village, and they pinch the little ones at play.
Thin them, and bring me three of their claws. Then I will teach you a thing the tidewardens know.
Will you hunt them?
quests.declined: Then the little ones keep their toes out of the water.
quests.started: Three claws. West, along the sea floor.

steps.journal: Take three shore crab claws from the shore crabs on the sea floor west of the village.
Bring three shore crab claws to Tidewarden Merrow.
steps.says: Three claws, and all your fingers still on. Now watch, and learn this.

quests.name: Arms from the Sea
quests.offer:
You will need better than your bare hands among the dry folk. I will make you proper gear, but you will bring what it needs.
Shellwright Pearla has cord and a shaft set aside. Then take a shell plate from the strand turtles on the sea floor south of the village.
Will you bring me all three?
quests.declined: Then keep your fins sharp.
quests.started: Cord and a shaft from Pearla, a shell plate from the turtles. Go.

steps.journal: Ask Shellwright Pearla for the silk cord and the wooden shaft.
steps.says: For Merrow? He never says please. Here: cord, and a shaft cut straight from driftwood.

steps.journal: Take a shell plate from the strand turtles on the sea floor south of the village.
Bring the silk cord, the wooden shaft and the shell plate to Tidewarden Merrow.
steps.says: All three. A moment... there. It is yours. Keep it bright: the salt is hard on steel.

quests.name: Old Snapjaw
quests.offer:
One task more. An old shark hunts the deep water far west of the village. Old Snapjaw, the little ones call him, and he has taken fish from our nets for years.
He is mean and he is old, and he will come at you on sight. Bring him down, and bring me a tooth of his so the village knows.
Will you hunt Old Snapjaw?
quests.declined: He will be there. He always is.
quests.started: West, out past the crabs, into the deep water. He will see you first.

steps.journal: Take a tooth from Old Snapjaw in the deep water far west of the village.
Bring Old Snapjaw's tooth to Tidewarden Merrow.
steps.says:
The old snapper is gone? The nets will be full tonight. You are a little fin no longer.
Learn this, and go to Gatekeeper Thalassa, north-west of the village, when you are ready for Highbourne.

quests.name: The Tide to Highbourne
quests.offer:
The scholars of Highbourne, on Tunaria's western shore, have long traded with the merfolk. They will teach you as one of their own.
You have earned the tide, little fin. I will set you down among your own guild in Highbourne, and your spirit will rest there.
Shall I send you to Highbourne?
quests.declined: The tide will wait for you.
quests.started: Swim well, and sing for us!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Thalassa when you are ready to go to Highbourne.

quests.name: Two Tasks on the Ice
quests.offer:
The Homelands keep a hunters' outpost on the frozen river under the Goldfeather Eyrie. Every home sends its young hunters there, and so will the strand.
Ride Dorran's coach to the Eyrie. Bring me drift rat fur and a badger's pelt from the snow east of the outpost.
Will you hunt the Eyrie's snow for me?
quests.declined: The snow will keep. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Dorran's coach will take you. Keep your scales warm: that water is frozen.

steps.journal: Take two clumps of drift rat fur from the drift rats east of the Eyrie outpost.
Take a snowfield badger pelt from the badgers on the snow east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the drift rat fur and the badger pelt to Tidewarden Merrow.
steps.says: Good fur, and a good pelt. The cold did not stop you. Now watch closely, and learn this.

quests.name: Arms of the Eyrie
quests.offer:
You have grown past the arms of a little fin. I will make you better, but the outpost has what I need.
Quartermaster Dunmore keeps good ore at the Eyrie outpost. Then bring me silk from the rime spiders north-east of it.
Will you bring me the ore and the silk?
quests.declined: Then your old arms will have to do.
quests.started: Ore from Dunmore, silk from the spiders. Go.

steps.journal: Ask Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost for the ore Merrow needs.
steps.says: One of the merfolk, this far from the sea? Merrow's word came by the coach. Here, the best ore in my stores.

steps.journal: Take two skeins of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the iron ore and the rime spider silk to Tidewarden Merrow.
steps.says: Ore for the blade, silk to bind the grip. A moment... there. It is yours: carry it well.

quests.name: Old Frostjaw
quests.offer:
The outpost's hunters have lost three of their own to an old snow leopard they call Frostjaw. He hunts the slopes north-east of the outpost.
Bring him down, and I will teach you what the tidewardens teach at your age. Take friends from the other homes if you are wise.
Will you hunt Old Frostjaw?
quests.declined: He will not grow old enough to die on his own.
quests.started: Go with friends. He strikes first and he strikes hard.

steps.journal: Kill Old Frostjaw on the slopes north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
Return to Tidewarden Merrow.
steps.says: Frostjaw is gone? Then the outpost sleeps easier, and the strand is proud of you. Learn this.

quests.name: The Heart of the Rime
quests.offer:
Something old walks in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost. The hunters call it the Rimeheart, and the cold that follows it kills the snow's game.
Break it, and carry a shard of it to Warden Halvek, so the outpost knows it is done. Then come back to me.
Will you face the Rimeheart?
quests.declined: Then the caves grow colder.
quests.started: Do not go into those caves alone.

steps.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: So the Rimeheart is broken, and by one of the merfolk. I will send word to every home. Tell Merrow the Eyrie owes the strand a debt.

steps.journal: Return to Tidewarden Merrow.
steps.says: Halvek's word came by the coach before you did. You have done the strand proud. Learn this.

quests.name: The Long Tide
quests.offer:
Merrow says you are no little fin now. One of the merfolk who goes out into the world stands a watch at the Eyrie once, so the other homes know us.
Go to Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost and do as he asks. When it is done, come back to me, and choose your path.
Will you stand the watch?
quests.declined: The tide waits for those who are ready.
quests.started: Swim well, and come home.

steps.journal: Find Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: Coralyn sends you? Then you are ready for the eyrie. Scout Feyla watches it from the river's far reach: go to her.

steps.journal: Find Scout Feyla on the frozen river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: The Goldfeather raiders carry their eyrie's war-talons. Bring me three, and they will think twice before they raid the river again.

steps.journal: Take three war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the three war-talons to Scout Feyla.
steps.says: Three talons. The eyrie will be quiet tonight. Go home, swimmer: your elder waits for you.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Coralyn in the merfolk's village.
steps.says: You swam out a little fin and came home a hunter of the Homelands. The strand has one more thing to give you.

items.name: young giant's tooth thong
items.description: A rhino's tooth on a thong of thick hide. Every young giant of the West Plateau camp wears one.

items.name: plateau skink scale
items.description: A scale of a plateau skink from the plain west of the giants' camp.

items.name: rock badger claw
items.description: The claw of a rock badger from the plain south of the giants' camp.

items.name: Greyjaw's fang
items.description: A yellowed fang of the old wolf Greyjaw of the West Plateau.

items.name: snowfield badger pelt
items.description: The thick pelt of a snowfield badger of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

items.name: rime spider silk
items.description: A skein of frosted silk from a rime spider of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

items.name: shard of the Rimeheart
items.description: A shard of blue ice that never melts, broken from the Rimeheart.

items.name: Goldfeather war-talon
items.description: A war-talon of the Goldfeather aviaks, bound in gold thread.

items.name: cub's claw band
items.description: A band of woven palm and soft fur. Every cub of Kerra Isle wears one until its first hunt.

items.name: isle crab claw
items.description: The claw of an isle crab from the sand spit north of the kerrans' village.

items.name: fern viper fang
items.description: The fang of a fern viper from the ferns west of the kerrans' village.

items.name: Old Snapclaw's claw
items.description: The great notched claw of the crab Old Snapclaw of Kerra Isle.

items.name: drift rat fur
items.description: A clump of white fur from a drift rat of the Goldfeather Eyrie's snow.

items.name: river-shell charm
items.description: A chip of river shell on a reed cord. Every young kappa of the Dwell wears one.

items.name: marsh rat tail
items.description: The tail of a marsh rat from the shore where the Dwell's causeway lands.

items.name: braided reed cord
items.description: A length of river reed, braided tight by the Dwell's netmenders.

items.name: mudfang scale
items.description: A broad scale from a mudfang basilisk of the flats south of the Dwell's shore.

items.name: Gulpjaw's tooth
items.description: A long tooth of the blue basilisk Gulpjaw.

items.name: pup's digging sash
items.description: A sash of tunnel-rat hide, knotted in clan Kolbok's way. Every pup of the Warrens wears one.

items.name: tunnel beetle horn
items.description: The horn of a tunnel beetle from the west end of the Warrens.

items.name: rat-hide lacing
items.description: A long lace cut from tunnel-rat hide by the Warrens' stitchers.

items.name: deepway millipede leg
items.description: A hard, jointed leg from a deepway millipede of the Warrens' south tunnels.

items.name: Gravelmaw's mandible
items.description: A notched mandible of the scythe beetle Gravelmaw.

items.name: snowfield badger claw
items.description: A long digging claw from a snowfield badger of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

items.name: pale owl talon
items.description: A hooked talon from a pale owl of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

items.name: Old Frostjaw's claw
items.description: A hooked claw as long as a finger, taken from Old Frostjaw.

items.name: tideline ring
items.description: A ring of twisted wire scavenged from the tide line. Every young ratman of the shore camp wears one.

items.name: dune snake fang
items.description: The fang of a dune snake from the sand east of the ratmen's shore camp.

items.name: salvaged net cord
items.description: A length of tarred cord picked out of a net the tide left on the ratmen's shore.

items.name: tidewrack crab claw
items.description: The heavy claw of a tidewrack crab from the tide line by the ratmen's shore camp.

items.name: Hoodscale's fang
items.description: A long, hollow fang of the cobra Hoodscale.

items.name: reveler's bangle
items.description: A bangle of carved vine-wood that clicks in time when its wearer dances. Every young satyr of the glade wears one.

items.name: glade spiderling leg
items.description: The leg of a glade spiderling from the grass east of the satyrs' glade.

items.name: twisted vine cord
items.description: A cord of green vine, twisted tight by the reedcutters of the satyrs' glade.

items.name: mead wasp stinger
items.description: The stinger of a mead wasp from the woods south-east of the satyrs' glade.

items.name: Nightpelt's fang
items.description: A long fang of the shadow panther Nightpelt.

items.name: pale owl feather
items.description: A long white flight feather from a pale owl of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

items.name: frostpaw tuft
items.description: A tuft of thick white fur from a frostpaw cub of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

items.name: Goldfeather war-horn
items.description: A horn the Goldfeather raiders blow to gather before a raid.

items.name: acorn-cap earring
items.description: The cap of an acorn from the grove's first oak, hung on a thread of bark. Every young dryad of the grove wears one.

items.name: bark beetle shell
items.description: The shell of a bark beetle from the woods west of the dryads' lake.

items.name: willow-bark cord
items.description: A cord of willow bark, peeled and twisted by the weavers of the dryads' grove.

items.name: rootcoil snake skin
items.description: The mottled skin of a rootcoil snake from the deep woods west of the dryads' lake.

items.name: Rotbark's heartwood
items.description: A knot of blackened heartwood from the rotting shambler Rotbark.

items.name: drift rat incisor
items.description: A yellow gnawing tooth from a drift rat of the Goldfeather Eyrie's snow.

items.name: stonewake band
items.description: A band of crag-lizard hide set with a chip of the roost's own rock. Every newly woken gargoyle of the crag wears one.

items.name: crag bat wing
items.description: The leathery wing of a crag bat from the foot of the gargoyles' crag.

items.name: crag-hide thong
items.description: A thong cut from crag-lizard hide by the hidecutters of the gargoyles' roost.

items.name: cragside skink tail
items.description: The thick tail of a cragside skink from the barrens east of the gargoyles' crag.

items.name: Grindstone's core
items.description: The hard knot of rock at the heart of the sand-thing Grindstone.

items.name: rime spider fang
items.description: A fang of clear, frosted chitin from a rime spider of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

items.name: Old Frostjaw's fang
items.description: A long yellowed fang of the snow leopard Old Frostjaw.

items.name: novice's prayer beads
items.description: A string of grey stone beads from the temple of Envar. A novice of the Jal'Raeth counts its breaths on them.

items.name: ash grub tooth
items.description: The tooth of an ash grub from the dead hills east of Envar.

items.name: cinder adder fang
items.description: The fang of a cinder adder from the low hills north-east of Envar.

items.name: Hollow Pilgrim's bone
items.description: A brittle bone of the Hollow Pilgrim, to be laid back in the crypt of Envar.

items.name: fledgling's wingband
items.description: A band of knotted reed and down. Every fledgling of the Roost wears one on its wing.

items.name: scrub rat tail
items.description: The tail of a scrub rat from the grass north of the Roost.

items.name: brush wasp stinger
items.description: The stinger of a brush wasp from the hill west of the Roost.

items.name: Razortusk's tusk
items.description: The chipped tusk of the old boar Razortusk.

items.name: tunnel-runner's ear ring
items.description: A ring of rat bone and wire. Every goblin of Moss Mouth Cavern wears one, so the lookouts know it in the dark.

items.name: tunnel rat tail
items.description: The tail of a tunnel rat from the long tunnel of Moss Mouth Cavern.

items.name: cave bat wing
items.description: The leathery wing of a cave bat from the north-east chamber of Moss Mouth Cavern.

items.name: Mossweb's fang
items.description: The long black fang of the spider Mother Mossweb.

items.name: Old Frostjaw's pelt
items.description: The scarred grey pelt of Old Frostjaw, the snow leopard of the Eyrie's slopes.

items.name: hatchling's fang cord
items.description: A cord of swamp reed strung with a young gator's fang. Every hatchling of the Mirewatch wears one at its throat.

items.name: bog beetle shell
items.description: The green-black shell of a bog beetle from the south shore of the temple island.

items.name: marsh serpent fang
items.description: The curved fang of a marsh serpent from the east island of Cazic-Thule.

items.name: Snapjaw's tooth
items.description: A yellowed tooth, long as a hand, from the old alligator Snapjaw.

items.name: pale owl pinion
items.description: A long white flight feather from a pale owl of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

items.name: acorn-cap sash
items.description: A sash of plaited grass sewn with acorn caps. Every brownie of Mayfly Glade wears one, and keeps a crumb or two tucked in it.

items.name: mayfly wing
items.description: A glassy wing from a mayfly swarm of the hollow south of the stockade.

items.name: glade snake fang
items.description: The thin fang of a glade snake from the woods west of the stockade.

items.name: Greyback's claw
items.description: A blunt grey claw, as long as a brownie's arm, from the badger Old Greyback.

items.name: dewdrop ring
items.description: A ring of spider silk holding one drop of morning dew that never dries. Every pixie of the Misty Thicket wears one.

items.name: bramble rat tail
items.description: The tail of a bramble rat from the brambles south-west of the pines.

items.name: thicket beetle shell
items.description: The glossy shell of a thicket beetle from the low ground east of the pines.

items.name: Redsting's stinger
items.description: The barbed red stinger of the hornet Redsting, as long as a pixie's arm.

items.name: drift rat whisker
items.description: A stiff white whisker from a drift rat of the Goldfeather Eyrie's snow.

items.name: moonpetal bracelet
items.description: A bracelet braided from the pale flowers that open at moonrise in the valley of the Twisted Tower. They do not wilt.

items.name: dusk beetle eye
items.description: The faintly glowing eye of a dusk beetle from the west end of the valley.

items.name: valley raven feather
items.description: A glossy black tail feather from a raven of the valley of the Twisted Tower.

items.name: Cindersnap's scale
items.description: A warm, ember-coloured scale from the young drake Cindersnap.

items.name: moonpetal thread
items.description: A spool of thread spun from moonpetals. It glows faintly in the dark.

items.name: pup's pack collar
items.description: A collar of badger hide, branded with the mark of Blackburrow. Every pup of the pack wears one.

items.name: hill badger pelt
items.description: The striped pelt of a hill badger from the hill north-west of Blackburrow.

items.name: ridge viper fang
items.description: The hooked fang of a ridge viper from the scrub south of Blackburrow.

items.name: Greymuzzle's fang
items.description: A long yellow fang from the old wolf Greymuzzle.

items.name: Thedruk war band
items.description: A band of boiled hide, branded with the camp's mark. Every whelp of Thedruk wears one on its arm.

items.name: camp rat tail
items.description: The tail of a camp rat from the grass west of Thedruk.

items.name: scree spider leg
items.description: The hard, jointed leg of a scree spider from the rocks north of Thedruk.

items.name: Scarback's claw
items.description: A black claw, notched from old fights, from the bear Old Scarback.

items.name: calf's nose ring
items.description: A ring of dark Gerntar iron. Every calf of the Rustel herd is given one.

items.name: mine rat tail
items.description: The tail of a mine rat from the grass east of the Gerntar Mines.

items.name: ore beetle shell
items.description: The hard shell of an ore beetle from the rise south-east of the Gerntar Mines.

items.name: Gorespine's spine
items.description: A long black spine from the back of the young spineback Gorespine.

items.name: waking band
items.description: A band of tarnished bronze from the kings' stores. Each of the woken dead of the tomb wears one.

items.name: tomb beetle shell
items.description: The cracked shell of a tomb beetle from the excavators' pit in the Tomb of Kings.

items.name: crypt bat wing
items.description: The leathery wing of a crypt bat from the south passage of the Tomb of Kings.

items.name: stolen burial seal
items.description: A seal of old ivory, pried from a king's door by the robber Sela.

items.name: sprout's root sash
items.description: A sash of braided rootlets, still damp. Every sprout of the hall in Guk wears one.

items.name: cave beetle shell
items.description: The shell of a cave beetle from the north-east passage of the hall in Guk.

items.name: muck roach wing
items.description: The stiff wing of a muck roach from the east tunnel of the hall in Guk.

items.name: Old Manylegs' shell plate
items.description: A broad plate from the back of the great centipede Old Manylegs.

items.name: frostpaw cub claw
items.description: A small, sharp claw from a frostpaw cub of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

items.name: marsh-glass bead
items.description: A bead of green marsh glass on a reed cord. A wisp's light gathers in it and does not thin.

items.name: bog rat tail
items.description: The tail of a bog rat from the reeds of the West Feerrott.

items.name: bog gnat wing
items.description: A wing, thin as breath, from the gnats over the south pools of the West Feerrott.

items.name: Duskpaw's fang
items.description: A fang of the young jaguar Duskpaw, who hunted the lights of the West Feerrott.

items.name: pale owl eye
items.description: The wide, pale eye of an owl of the Goldfeather Eyrie, that sees by night.

items.name: tide shell earring
items.description: A small spiral shell from the warm shallows of Erud's Crossing, carved for a young one of the merfolk.

items.name: shore crab claw
items.description: The claw of a shore crab from the sea floor west of the merfolk's village.

items.name: strand turtle shell plate
items.description: A plate of a strand turtle's shell from the sea floor south of the merfolk's village.

items.name: Old Snapjaw's tooth
items.description: A long, notched tooth of Old Snapjaw, the old shark of the deep water west of the merfolk's village.
